title: AudioLift: Audio-Driven Single Image to Full-Head Gaussian Avatar via Multi-view Video Generation
title_zh: AudioLift：通过多视图视频生成实现音频驱动的单图像到全头高斯化身

paragraphs.en: Existing 3D talking avatar methods mainly rely on parametric face models including 3DMM or FLAME, whose compact motion representations limit their ability to synthesize extreme expressions and to model accessories such as headwear. We introduce AudioLift , a two-stage framework that uses generated multi-view videos as the intermediate representation for audio-driven avatar generation without parametric face models or per-instance optimization. Our framework combines a synchronized multi-view video generation stage with an inconsistency-robust Gaussian reconstruction stage to recover coherent full-head geometry from a single portrait image. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AudioLift produces 3D talking avatars capable of capturing more extreme facial expressions than existing methods, with improved geometric completeness and strong multi-view consistency across the full 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} viewing range. Project page: https://zhuoyuanjiang.github.io/audiolift-page/
paragraphs.zh: 现有的3D说话头像方法主要依赖参数化人脸模型，如3DMM或FLAME，其紧凑的运动表示限制了它们合成极端表情以及建模头饰等配饰的能力。 我们提出AudioLift，这是一个两阶段框架，它将生成的多视角视频作为中间表示，用于音频驱动的头像生成，无需参数化人脸模型或逐实例优化。 我们的框架将多视角视频同步生成阶段与对不一致性鲁棒的高斯重建阶段相结合，从单张人像图像中恢复连贯的全头部几何。 大量实验表明，AudioLift生成的3D说话头像能够捕捉比现有方法更极端的面部表情，同时具有更好的几何完整性，并在整个360 ∘ 360^{\circ}观察范围内保持强多视角一致性。 项目主页：https://zhuoyuanjiang.github.io/audiolift-page/

paragraphs.en: Audio-driven talking avatars reproduce a person’s appearance and animate facial motion from speech. They have attracted considerable attention in computer vision and graphics because of their applications in virtual communication, games, and augmented and virtual reality. Unlike 2D portrait animation, 3D talking avatars can be rendered from arbitrary viewpoints, allowing the camera to move around a speaking character.
paragraphs.zh: 音频驱动的说话虚拟形象能够再现一个人的外貌，并根据语音生成面部动作。 由于在虚拟通信、游戏以及增强现实和虚拟现实中的应用，它们在计算机视觉和图形学领域受到了广泛关注。 与二维肖像动画不同，三维说话虚拟形象可以从任意视点进行渲染，使摄像机能够围绕说话的角色移动。

sents.en: Audio-driven talking avatars reproduce a person’s appearance and animate facial motion from speech.
sents.zh: 音频驱动的说话虚拟形象能够再现一个人的外貌，并根据语音生成面部动作。

sents.en: They have attracted considerable attention in computer vision and graphics because of their applications in virtual communication, games, and augmented and virtual reality.
sents.zh: 由于在虚拟通信、游戏以及增强现实和虚拟现实中的应用，它们在计算机视觉和图形学领域受到了广泛关注。

sents.en: Unlike 2D portrait animation, 3D talking avatars can be rendered from arbitrary viewpoints, allowing the camera to move around a speaking character.
sents.zh: 与二维肖像动画不同，三维说话虚拟形象可以从任意视点进行渲染，使摄像机能够围绕说话的角色移动。

paragraphs.en: Creating a 3D talking avatar typically requires monocular video or multi-view captures of the target person, followed by optimization for each new identity ( Guo et al., 2021 ; Peng et al., 2024 ; Aneja et al., 2025 ) . We instead study a more constrained setting of constructing a high-quality full-head talking avatar from only a single portrait and an audio sequence, without per-instance optimization. This would allow avatars to be created from casually captured photos. The task presents two challenges. First, a single image leaves the geometry of the full head, especially its unseen regions, ambiguous, making consistent rendering from novel viewpoints difficult. Second, generating realistic facial motion from audio requires mapping a one-dimensional signal to complex 3D facial dynamics while preserving temporal coherence.
paragraphs.zh: 创建 3D 说话头像通常需要目标人物的单目视频或多视角采集，然后针对每个新身份进行优化（Guo et al., 2021; Peng et al., 2024; Aneja et al., 2025）。 我们转而研究一个更具约束性的设定：仅从单张人像和一段音频序列构建高质量的全头说话头像，且无需逐实例优化。 这将使得头像可以由随手拍摄的照片创建。 该任务带来两个挑战。 首先，单张图像使全头的几何形状，尤其是其未被看到的区域，存在歧义，导致从新视角进行一致渲染变得困难。 其次，从音频生成真实的面部运动需要将一维信号映射到复杂的 3D 面部动态，同时保持时间上的连贯性。

sents.zh: 这将使得头像可以由随手拍摄的照片创建。

sents.en: The task presents two challenges.

sents.en: Second, generating realistic facial motion from audio requires mapping a one-dimensional signal to complex 3D facial dynamics while preserving temporal coherence.
sents.zh: 其次，从音频生成真实的面部运动需要将一维信号映射到复杂的 3D 面部动态，同时保持时间上的连贯性。

paragraphs.en: A common approach first reconstructs a canonical 3D avatar, then maps audio to compact motion coefficients, often based on 3DMM ( Blanz and Vetter, 1999 ) or FLAME ( Li et al., 2017 ) , that deform the avatar ( Ye et al., 2024 ; Kim et al., 2024 ; Gong et al., 2025 ; He et al., 2025 ) . While these parametric models provide useful facial structure and coordinated deformation, their low-dimensional parametric space struggles to capture subtle facial dynamics and extreme emotions, and movements of hair or accessories. To address this limitation of expressivity, recent methods try to add extra modules on top of the parametric model, such as free-form per-Gaussian deformation, to recover the dynamics it misses ( Xu et al., 2025 ; Taubner et al., 2025a ; Taubner et al., 2025b ) . However, the need for these additional deformation modules motivates us to rethink the intermediate medium for driving facial motion: could we shift the intermediate medium from a restrictive parametric representation like FLAME to a richer visual medium?
paragraphs.zh: 一种常见做法是先重建一个规范的三维化身，然后将音频映射为紧凑的运动系数（通常基于 3DMM（Blanz and Vetter, 1999）或 FLAME（Li et al., 2017）），再利用这些系数对化身进行变形（Ye et al., 2024; Kim et al., 2024; Gong et al., 2025; He et al., 2025）。 尽管这些参数化模型提供了有用的人脸结构和协调的变形，但其低维参数空间难以捕捉细微的面部动态、极端情绪以及头发或饰物的运动。 为解决这一表达能力上的局限，近来的方法尝试在参数化模型之上添加额外模块，例如自由形式的高斯基元变形，以恢复其遗漏的动态（Xu et al., 2025; Taubner et al., 2025a; Taubner et al., 2025b）。 然而，对这些额外变形模块的需求促使我们重新思考驱动面部运动的中间媒介：能否将中间媒介从 FLAME 这类受限的参数化表示转换为一种更丰富的视觉媒介？

paragraphs.en: Recent audio-driven video models offer another route. Trained on large collections of talking-face videos, they can directly synthesize detailed, time-varying facial appearance from a portrait and audio, including mouth shapes and expression-dependent skin detail ( Tian et al., 2024 ; Xu et al., 2024 ; Cui et al., 2024 ; Tu et al., 2025 ) . Since the generated frames already encode dense facial motion, we can bypass parametric coefficients entirely. The complex audio-to-motion synthesis is thus offloaded to the video model, while the 3D stage reconstructs a representation that explains the generated frames. This transforms 4D avatar generation from a deformation problem into a pure reconstruction task.
paragraphs.zh: 最近的音频驱动视频模型提供了另一条路线。 通过在大量说话人脸视频集合上训练，这些模型可以直接从一张人像和音频合成细致的、随时间变化的面部外观，包括嘴型和依赖表情的皮肤细节（Tian et al., 2024；Xu et al., 2024；Cui et al., 2024；Tu et al., 2025）。 由于生成的帧已经编码了稠密的面部运动，我们可以完全绕过参数化系数。 因此，复杂的音频到运动的合成被卸载给视频模型，而3D阶段则重建一种能解释所生成帧的表示。 这将4D虚拟形象生成从形变问题转变为纯粹的重建任务。

sents.zh: 最近的音频驱动视频模型提供了另一条路线。

sents.zh: 这将4D虚拟形象生成从形变问题转变为纯粹的重建任务。

paragraphs.en: In this work, we present AudioLift , a framework for generating a full-head 3D talking avatar from a single image and an audio sequence input. Inspired by recent advances in single-image-to-3D object generation ( Long et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2024c ; Shi et al., 2023 ) which generate multi-view images for lifting an image to 3D, our approach uses an audio-conditioned 2D video model ( Tu et al., 2025 ) built on Wan ( Wang et al., 2025 ) to generate multi-view videos of the talking head. A feed-forward Gaussian reconstructor then lifts the generated views at each time step into a 3D Gaussian representation that can be rendered from arbitrary viewpoints ( Zhang et al., 2024 ; Lyu et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出了 AudioLift，一个从单张图像和音频序列输入生成完整头部 3D 说话虚拟人的框架。 受近期单图像到 3D 物体生成进展（Long et al., 2024；Li et al., 2024c；Shi et al., 2023）的启发，这些方法通过生成多视角图像将图像提升为 3D，我们的方法使用一个基于 Wan（Wang et al., 2025）构建的音频条件 2D 视频模型（Tu et al., 2025）来生成说话头部的多视角视频。 然后一个前馈高斯重建器将每个时间步生成的视角提升为可以从任意视点渲染的 3D 高斯表示（Zhang et al., 2024；Lyu et al., 2025）。

sents.en: In this work, we present AudioLift , a framework for generating a full-head 3D talking avatar from a single image and an audio sequence input.
sents.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出了 AudioLift，一个从单张图像和音频序列输入生成完整头部 3D 说话虚拟人的框架。

sents.zh: 受近期单图像到 3D 物体生成进展（Long et al., 2024；Li et al., 2024c；Shi et al., 2023）的启发，这些方法通过生成多视角图像将图像提升为 3D，我们的方法使用一个基于 Wan（Wang et al., 2025）构建的音频条件 2D 视频模型（Tu et al., 2025）来生成说话头部的多视角视频。

sents.en: A feed-forward Gaussian reconstructor then lifts the generated views at each time step into a 3D Gaussian representation that can be rendered from arbitrary viewpoints ( Zhang et al., 2024 ; Lyu et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: 然后一个前馈高斯重建器将每个时间步生成的视角提升为可以从任意视点渲染的 3D 高斯表示（Zhang et al., 2024；Lyu et al., 2025）。

paragraphs.en: This approach poses two challenges. First, the generated 2D videos must maintain multi-view consistency, depicting the same audio-driven performance across all viewpoints at every time step. Since independently generating videos for individual views does not inherently guarantee cross-view consistency because of the stochastic nature of the diffusion process, we arrange videos from four oblique viewpoints in a 2 × 2 2\times 2 canvas and generate them jointly with a frontal view. In this layout, the model’s internal self-attention naturally facilitates cross-view interaction, thereby promoting appearance consistency across viewpoints. Second, obtaining a high-quality full-head 3D representation from imperfect generated views remains challenging. Minor cross-view inconsistencies can produce floating geometry and duplicated surfaces. We address these issues by training the reconstructor with view-aware corruption and structural priors to make it robust to imperfect inputs and capable of completing unseen parts of the head. The result is a clean, compact Gaussian avatar that supports full 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} free-view rendering.
paragraphs.zh: 这种方法带来了两个挑战。 首先，生成的2D视频必须保持多视角一致性，在每一个时间步中，从所有视角描绘同一段由音频驱动的表演。 由于扩散过程的随机性，为各个视角独立生成视频本质上无法保证跨视角一致性，因此我们将来自四个斜向视角的视频排列在一个 2 \times 2 的画布中，并与一个正面视角一起联合生成。 在这种布局下，模型内部的自注意力机制自然地促进了跨视角交互，从而提升各视角之间外观的一致性。 其次，从不完美的生成视角中获得高质量的完整头部3D表示仍然具有挑战性。 轻微的跨视角不一致可能产生漂浮的几何体和重复的表面。 我们通过使用视角感知的腐蚀和结构先验来训练重建器，从而解决这些问题，使其对不完美的输入具有鲁棒性，并能够补全头部的未见部分。 最终结果是一个干净、紧凑的高斯智能体化身，支持完整的 360^{\circ} 自由视角渲染。

sents.en: This approach poses two challenges.
sents.zh: 这种方法带来了两个挑战。

sents.en: First, the generated 2D videos must maintain multi-view consistency, depicting the same audio-driven performance across all viewpoints at every time step.
sents.zh: 首先，生成的2D视频必须保持多视角一致性，在每一个时间步中，从所有视角描绘同一段由音频驱动的表演。

sents.en: Since independently generating videos for individual views does not inherently guarantee cross-view consistency because of the stochastic nature of the diffusion process, we arrange videos from four oblique viewpoints in a 2 × 2 2\times 2 canvas and generate them jointly with a frontal view.
sents.zh: 由于扩散过程的随机性，为各个视角独立生成视频本质上无法保证跨视角一致性，因此我们将来自四个斜向视角的视频排列在一个 2 \times 2 的画布中，并与一个正面视角一起联合生成。

sents.zh: 在这种布局下，模型内部的自注意力机制自然地促进了跨视角交互，从而提升各视角之间外观的一致性。

sents.en: Second, obtaining a high-quality full-head 3D representation from imperfect generated views remains challenging.
sents.zh: 其次，从不完美的生成视角中获得高质量的完整头部3D表示仍然具有挑战性。

sents.en: Minor cross-view inconsistencies can produce floating geometry and duplicated surfaces.
sents.zh: 轻微的跨视角不一致可能产生漂浮的几何体和重复的表面。

sents.en: We address these issues by training the reconstructor with view-aware corruption and structural priors to make it robust to imperfect inputs and capable of completing unseen parts of the head.
sents.zh: 我们通过使用视角感知的腐蚀和结构先验来训练重建器，从而解决这些问题，使其对不完美的输入具有鲁棒性，并能够补全头部的未见部分。

sents.en: The result is a clean, compact Gaussian avatar that supports full 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} free-view rendering.
sents.zh: 最终结果是一个干净、紧凑的高斯智能体化身，支持完整的 360^{\circ} 自由视角渲染。

paragraphs.en: We introduce AudioLift , a generalizable framework that creates a full-head 3D Gaussian talking avatar from a single portrait and audio, including vivid and extreme expressions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 AudioLift，一个可泛化的框架，能够从单张肖像和音频生成完整头部的 3D 高斯说话智能体，包括生动和极端的表情。

paragraphs.en: We generate four audio-driven oblique views jointly in a 2 × 2 2\times 2 video grid with a frontal view, using the video model’s self-attention to promote cross-view consistency.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 2 × 2 2\times 2 视频网格中，结合一个正面视图，联合生成四个音频驱动的斜视图，利用视频模型的自注意力机制促进跨视图一致性。

paragraphs.en: We develop a Gaussian head reconstructor that handles inconsistent views through view-aware corruption and active-volume regularization, and completes unseen rear regions through conservative rear-prior distillation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们开发了一个高斯头部重建器，通过视角感知腐蚀与主动体正则化来处理不一致的视角，并通过保守的后部先验蒸馏来补全未见的后部区域。

paragraphs.en: Experiments on benchmark datasets and in-the-wild examples show improved identity preservation, expression quality, and novel-view fidelity over existing methods.
paragraphs.zh: 在基准数据集和真实场景样本上的实验表明，与现有方法相比，该方法在身份保持、表情质量和新视角保真度方面均有提升。

paragraphs.en: Audio-driven 2D talking heads. Early methods animate a portrait using lip synchronization, 3DMM-based warping, or diffusion conditioned on facial landmarks ( Prajwal et al., 2020 ; Zhang et al., 2023 ; Wei et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) . More recent video diffusion models generate a talking-head video directly from a portrait and audio ( Tian et al., 2024 ; Cui et al., 2025 ; Cui et al., 2024 ; Lin et al., 2025a ; Gan et al., 2025 ; Tu et al., 2025 ; Cai et al., 2026 ) . By modeling appearance and motion jointly, they can capture fine facial dynamics as well as motion of hair and headwear. Their single-view outputs, however, provide no explicit 3D representation for rendering from new viewpoints. We adapt an audio-driven video model ( Tu et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) to generate synchronized views, then reconstruct a 3D Gaussian avatar from them.
paragraphs.zh: 音频驱动的二维说话人头。 早期方法通过唇形同步、基于3DMM的形变，或以面部关键点为条件的扩散模型来驱动肖像动画（Prajwal et al., 2020；Zhang et al., 2023；Wei et al., 2024；Chen et al., 2025）。 更近期的视频扩散模型则直接从肖像和音频生成说话人头视频（Tian et al., 2024；Cui et al., 2025；Cui et al., 2024；Lin et al., 2025a；Gan et al., 2025；Tu et al., 2025；Cai et al., 2026）。 通过联合建模外观与运动，它们既能捕捉细腻的面部动态，也能捕捉头发和头饰的运动。 然而，其单视角输出无法提供用于新视角渲染的显式三维表示。 我们改造音频驱动的视频模型（Tu et al., 2025；Wang et al., 2025）来生成同步的多个视角，然后据此重建三维高斯虚拟形象。

paragraphs.en: 3D talking avatars and parametric head templates. Early methods fit a radiance field ( Guo et al., 2021 ; Li et al., 2023 ; Peng et al., 2024 ) or Gaussian avatar ( Cho et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2024b ; Aneja et al., 2025 ) to video or multi-view captures of each person. One-shot methods generalize across identities, but often use parametric motion: Real3D-Portrait ( Ye et al., 2024 ) , NeRFFaceSpeech ( Kim et al., 2024 ) , and MGGTalk ( Gong et al., 2025 ) use audio-driven 3DMM motion to animate their respective tri-plane, StyleNeRF, and point-cloud representations. Other approaches augment FLAME ( Li et al., 2017 ) with free-form Gaussian deformation but require optimization for each person ( Xu et al., 2025 ; Taubner et al., 2025b ; Taubner et al., 2025a ) . SDTalk ( Jia et al., 2026 ) predicts Gaussian motion from audio in one pass but still uses FLAME to complete occluded facial regions. In contrast, we generate audio-driven multi-view video and reconstruct a full-head Gaussian avatar without parametric motion or per-person optimization.
paragraphs.zh: 3D说话头像与参数化头部模板。 早期方法将辐射场（Guo et al., 2021；Li et al., 2023；Peng et al., 2024）或高斯头像（Cho et al., 2024；Li et al., 2024b；Aneja et al., 2025）拟合到每个人的视频或多视角采集数据上。 单样本方法可以跨身份泛化，但通常使用参数化运动：Real3D-Portrait（Ye et al., 2024）、NeRFFaceSpeech（Kim et al., 2024）和MGGTalk（Gong et al., 2025）使用音频驱动的3DMM运动来分别驱动各自的三平面、StyleNeRF和点云表示。 其他方法在FLAME（Li et al., 2017）的基础上加入自由形式的高斯形变，但需要对每个人进行优化（Xu et al., 2025；Taubner et al., 2025b；Taubner et al., 2025a）。 SDTalk（Jia et al., 2026）通过一次前向预测从音频预测高斯运动，但仍使用FLAME来补全被遮挡的面部区域。 与之相比，我们生成音频驱动的多视角视频，并构建完整的头部高斯头像，无需参数化运动或针对个人的优化。

paragraphs.en: Multi-view generation and reconstruction. Generating multiple views with a diffusion model and reconstructing 3D from them is an established approach to single-image or text-to-3D generation ( Shi et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2024a ; Gao et al., 2024 ; Voleti et al., 2024 ; Lyu et al., 2025 ; Lin et al., 2025b ; Liu et al., 2026 ; You et al., 2026 ) . To promote cross-view consistency, methods either share self-attention across view tokens ( Shi et al., 2024 ; Gao et al., 2024 ; Kant et al., 2024 ) or introduce dedicated cross-view layers ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024 ; Gao et al., 2025 ; Bai et al., 2025 ) . Most use image generators, whose frame-by-frame application can produce temporal flicker. Recent methods therefore use video backbones to generate multi-view sequences ( Shao et al., 2024 ; Taubner et al., 2025a ; Cheng et al., 2026 ; Jin et al., 2026 ; Lyu et al., 2026b ) , but require reference video, pose, or 3DMM controls. Our first stage generates synchronized multi-view video from only a portrait and audio; our second stage reconstructs a 3D avatar from the generated frames.
paragraphs.zh: 多视角生成与重建。 先用扩散模型生成多个视角，再据此重建三维，是单图像或文本到三维生成的一种成熟方法（ Shi et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2024a ; Gao et al., 2024 ; Voleti et al., 2024 ; Lyu et al., 2025 ; Lin et al., 2025b ; Liu et al., 2026 ; You et al., 2026 ）。 为促进跨视角一致性，现有方法要么在视角令牌之间共享自注意力（ Shi et al., 2024 ; Gao et al., 2024 ; Kant et al., 2024 ），要么引入专门的跨视角层（ Huang et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024 ; Gao et al., 2025 ; Bai et al., 2025 ）。 大多数方法使用图像生成器，其逐帧应用可能产生时间上的闪烁。 因此，最近的方法使用视频骨干网络来生成多视角序列（ Shao et al., 2024 ; Taubner et al., 2025a ; Cheng et al., 2026 ; Jin et al., 2026 ; Lyu et al., 2026b ），但需要参考视频、姿态或 3MM 控制条件。 我们的第一阶段仅从一段人像和音频生成同步的多视角视频；第二阶段从生成的帧重建三维数字人。

paragraphs.en: Stage I instantiates 𝒟 θ \mathcal{D}_{\theta} with StableAvatar’s audio-conditioned video diffusion transformer ( Wang et al., 2025 ; Tu et al., 2025 ) (Fig. 2 (a)). It generates five synchronized videos: four oblique views in a × 2 2\!\times\!2 canvas C C and a frontal view in a separate stream F F . To obtain consistent multi-view evidence, we first stitch four oblique views into a × 2 2\!\times\!2 canvas, allowing the four views to exchange information through spatial self-attention during denoising. Starting from this four-view model, we later found that adding a frontal view improves downstream reconstruction, as shown in our ablation. We therefore retain the four-view canvas C C and add a fifth frontal stream F F .
paragraphs.zh: 阶段 I 使用 StableAvatar 的音频条件视频扩散Transformer（Wang et al., 2025；Tu et al., 2025）实例化 𝒟 θ \mathcal{D}_{\theta}（图 2 (a)）。 它生成五个同步视频：× 2 2\!\times\!2 画布 C C 中的四个斜视图，以及独立流 F F 中的一个正面视图。 为了获得一致的多视角证据，我们首先将四个斜视图拼接成一个 × 2 2\!\times\!2 画布，使四个视图在去噪过程中能够通过空间自注意力交换信息。 从这个四视图模型出发，我们后来发现加入正面视图可以改善下游重建，如我们的消融实验所示。 因此，我们保留四视图画布 C C 并添加第五个正面流 F F 。

paragraphs.en: Audio-conditioned multi-view diffusion. We encode the oblique-view 2 × 2 2\times 2 canvas stream C C and frontal stream F F separately with the same frozen VAE, obtaining latent sequences z c z_{c} and z f z_{f} . During diffusion, we add noise to both sequences at the same noise level σ \sigma , yielding z c , σ z_{c,\sigma} and z f , σ z_{f,\sigma} . To better preserve identity information throughout denoising, we separately encode the reference portrait with the same frozen VAE to obtain a clean reference latent z ref z_{\mathrm{ref}} . We prepend z ref z_{\mathrm{ref}} along the temporal dimension to the noisy canvas latent sequence, forming z ~ c \tilde{z}_{c} ; the frontal latent sequence receives a zero placeholder at the same temporal position, forming z ~ f \tilde{z}_{f} . Implementation details of reference conditioning are provided in Appendix C.1 .

paragraphs.en: To condition the five views on the input speech, we use cross-attention to let visual tokens at the same latent time attend only to the audio context for the corresponding time. Specifically, a frozen Wav2Vec2 encoder ( Baevski et al., 2020 ) extracts speech features from a a . An audio adapter ( Tu et al., 2025 ) then converts each local window of these speech features into an audio context for the corresponding latent video time step. In every transformer block, canvas and frontal tokens at the same latent time attend to the same audio context through cross-attention, encouraging synchronized motion across views. Implementation details are provided in Appendix C.3 . After the shared output head, we reshape the sequence into per-time canvas and frontal token blocks and unpatchify each block onto its latent grid. Once denoising is complete, we decode both streams with the frozen VAE.
paragraphs.zh: 为了将五种视图以输入语音为条件，我们使用交叉注意力，让相同潜在时间点的视觉 token 仅关注对应时间点的音频上下文。 具体而言，一个冻结的 Wav2Vec2 编码器（Baevski et al., 2020）从 a a 中提取语音特征。 然后，音频适配器（Tu et al., 2025）将这些语音特征的每个局部窗口转换为对应潜在视频时间步的音频上下文。 在每个 transformer 块中，相同潜在时间点的画布 token 和正面 token 通过交叉注意力关注相同的音频上下文，从而促进各视图间的运动同步。 实现细节见附录 C.3。 在共享输出头之后，我们将序列重塑为每个时间点的画布 token 块和正面 token 块，并将每个块 unpatchify 到其潜在网格上。 去噪完成后，我们使用冻结的 VAE 对两个流进行解码。

paragraphs.en: Training objective. We apply StableAvatar’s weighted flow-matching objective to both streams, ℒ FM = ℒ c + ℒ f \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{FM}}=\mathcal{L}_{c}+\mathcal{L}_{f} . For each training sample, the canvas and frontal streams share the same sampled flow time and the same randomly selected full-frame, face-focused, or lip-focused weighting mode. We fine-tune the self-attention layers, shared patch projection, and output head, while keeping the remaining VAE and conditioning modules frozen. Appendix C.4 specifies the loss weights, inherited auxiliary term, and training scope.

paragraphs.en: View-aware corruption. Although multi-view consistency of the input videos is ensured by cross-view attention in the video diffusion model, minor imperfections in facial attributes or head poses can still exist, due to the uncertainty of diffusion generation. For 3D reconstruction, these inconsistent cues can create duplicated surfaces and view-dependent floaters. Directly fine-tuning the reconstructor with generated multi-view videos from Stage-I gave unsatisfactory results, as the generated expressions may differ from the ground truth. We therefore train on recorded multi-view videos but apply view-aware corruption inspired by LGM ( Tang et al., 2024 ) to the input videos to mimic structured disagreement among generated views: smooth grid distortion locally warps image content while keeping its camera parameters fixed, simulating local geometric mismatch across views; orbit-camera jitter perturbs the nominal camera pose while keeping the image fixed, simulating generated views that do not exactly follow their requested cameras. Because the frontal view provides the strongest identity and expression cue, we keep the frontal view clean without corruptions and independently corrupt the other views. This preserves a reliable anchor while teaching the lifter to reconcile imperfect oblique evidence. All reconstruction targets remain clean.
paragraphs.zh: 视角感知的损坏。 尽管输入视频的多视角一致性由视频扩散模型中的跨视角注意力机制保证，但由于扩散生成的不确定性，面部属性或头部姿态仍可能存在细微的不完美。 对于三维重建而言，这些不一致的线索会造成重复的表面以及依赖视角的漂浮物。 直接使用第一阶段生成的多视角视频对重建器进行微调效果不佳，因为生成的表情可能与真实值不同。 因此我们在录制的多视角视频上训练，但对输入视频施加受 LGM（Tang et al., 2024）启发的视角感知损坏，以模拟生成视角之间结构化的不一致：平滑网格畸变在局部扭曲图像内容的同时保持其相机参数不变，模拟视角间的局部几何失配；环绕相机抖动在保持图像不变的同时扰动标称相机位姿，模拟不完全遵循其请求相机的生成视角。 由于正面视角能提供最强的身份与表情线索，我们保持正面视角干净、不施加任何损坏，并对其他视角独立地施加损坏。 这在保留一个可靠锚点的同时，教会提升器去协调不完美的斜向证据。 所有重建目标均保持干净。

sents.en: View-aware corruption.
sents.zh: 视角感知的损坏。

sents.en: Although multi-view consistency of the input videos is ensured by cross-view attention in the video diffusion model, minor imperfections in facial attributes or head poses can still exist, due to the uncertainty of diffusion generation.
sents.zh: 尽管输入视频的多视角一致性由视频扩散模型中的跨视角注意力机制保证，但由于扩散生成的不确定性，面部属性或头部姿态仍可能存在细微的不完美。

sents.en: For 3D reconstruction, these inconsistent cues can create duplicated surfaces and view-dependent floaters.
sents.zh: 对于三维重建而言，这些不一致的线索会造成重复的表面以及依赖视角的漂浮物。

sents.en: Directly fine-tuning the reconstructor with generated multi-view videos from Stage-I gave unsatisfactory results, as the generated expressions may differ from the ground truth.
sents.zh: 直接使用第一阶段生成的多视角视频对重建器进行微调效果不佳，因为生成的表情可能与真实值不同。

sents.en: We therefore train on recorded multi-view videos but apply view-aware corruption inspired by LGM ( Tang et al., 2024 ) to the input videos to mimic structured disagreement among generated views: smooth grid distortion locally warps image content while keeping its camera parameters fixed, simulating local geometric mismatch across views; orbit-camera jitter perturbs the nominal camera pose while keeping the image fixed, simulating generated views that do not exactly follow their requested cameras.
sents.zh: 因此我们在录制的多视角视频上训练，但对输入视频施加受 LGM（Tang et al., 2024）启发的视角感知损坏，以模拟生成视角之间结构化的不一致：平滑网格畸变在局部扭曲图像内容的同时保持其相机参数不变，模拟视角间的局部几何失配；环绕相机抖动在保持图像不变的同时扰动标称相机位姿，模拟不完全遵循其请求相机的生成视角。

sents.en: Because the frontal view provides the strongest identity and expression cue, we keep the frontal view clean without corruptions and independently corrupt the other views.
sents.zh: 由于正面视角能提供最强的身份与表情线索，我们保持正面视角干净、不施加任何损坏，并对其他视角独立地施加损坏。

sents.en: This preserves a reliable anchor while teaching the lifter to reconcile imperfect oblique evidence.
sents.zh: 这在保留一个可靠锚点的同时，教会提升器去协调不完美的斜向证据。

sents.en: All reconstruction targets remain clean.
sents.zh: 所有重建目标均保持干净。

paragraphs.en: Active-volume regularization. Pixel alignment constrains each Gaussian to its source ray but leaves its depth underconstrained, allowing opacity-carrying sheets outside the head that become visible from novel views. We therefore introduce an active-volume loss ℒ AV \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{AV}} that penalizes pixel-aligned Gaussians outside a canonical head volume according to both their opacity and squared distance from the volume. The opacity term makes exterior Gaussians transparent, while the distance term moves active outliers toward the boundary. The loss formulation and implementation details are provided in Appendix D.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 活跃体积正则化。 像素对齐将每个高斯约束到其源光线上，但对其深度的约束不足，使得携带不透明度的薄片得以存在于头部之外，并在新视角下变得可见。 因此，我们引入活跃体积损失 ℒ AV \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{AV}}，根据不透明度以及与规范头部体积的距离平方，对位于该体积之外的像素对齐高斯进行惩罚。 不透明度项使外部高斯变得透明，而距离项则将活跃的离群高斯向体积边界移动。 该损失的公式与实现细节见附录 D.3。

sents.en: Active-volume regularization.
sents.zh: 活跃体积正则化。

paragraphs.en: Conservative rear distillation. We fine-tune the Gaussian head reconstructor with NeRSemble ( Kirschstein et al., 2023 ) dataset which only captures participants from the frontal arc, so the lack of rear-view supervision can lead to poor reconstruction of the back of the head. To achieve the goal of full-head reconstruction, we distill a frozen, released FaceLift ( Lyu et al., 2025 ) reconstructor whose pretraining provides a more plausible prior for rear completion. For each training scene, the teacher reconstructs the head from the fixed five clean source views. We then sample one virtual camera from each of three rear yaw ranges, [ 110 ∘ , 157 ∘ ) [110^{\circ},157^{\circ}) , [ 157 ∘ , 203 ∘ ) [157^{\circ},203^{\circ}) , and [ 203 ∘ , 250 ∘ ) [203^{\circ},250^{\circ}) , and cache the corresponding teacher renders as three pseudo-targets. A low-weight photometric and perceptual loss is then applied to these views to encourage plausible, rather than subject-exact, completion of the unseen rear.
paragraphs.zh: 保守的后部蒸馏。 我们使用 NeRSemble（Kirschstein et al., 2023）数据集对高斯头部重建器进行微调，该数据集仅从正面弧度范围拍摄参与者，因此后视图监督的缺失可能导致头部后部重建效果不佳。 为了实现全头重建的目标，我们蒸馏一个冻结的、已发布的 FaceLift（Lyu et al., 2025）重建器，其预训练为后部补全提供了更合理的先验。 对于每个训练场景，教师模型从固定的五个干净源视图重建头部。 然后我们从三个后部偏航角范围 [110^{\circ}, 157^{\circ})、[157^{\circ}, 203^{\circ}) 和 [203^{\circ}, 250^{\circ}) 中各采样一个虚拟相机，并将相应的教师渲染缓存为三个伪目标。 随后对这些视图施加低权重的光度损失和感知损失，以鼓励对未见后部进行合理的补全，而非与主体完全一致的补全。

paragraphs.en: Datasets. We train on 2,641 NeRSemble ( Kirschstein et al., 2023 ) speech sequences from 328 identities, reserving ten disjoint identities for development. Stage I uses the full training split. Stage II uses a fixed subset of 648 clips covering all 328 training identities, with approximately two clips per identity. We sample 16 frames per clip, yielding 10,368 synchronized multi-view scenes. For evaluation, we use 42 RenderMe-360 ( Pan et al., 2023 ) clips from 21 identities with 2 clips per identity and 21 HDTF ( Zhang et al., 2021 ) portrait-audio pairs. Quantitative evaluations on both datasets use 81-frame clips at 25 fps. Nevertheless, we support arbitrary-length inference. Additional in-the-wild and long-sequence demonstrations are provided on the project page.
paragraphs.zh: 数据集。 我们使用来自328个身份的2,641段NeRSemble（Kirschstein et al., 2023）语音序列进行训练，并保留十个互不重叠的身份用于开发。 阶段I使用完整的训练划分。 阶段II使用覆盖全部328个训练身份的648个片段的固定子集，每个身份约两个片段。 我们从每个片段采样16帧，得到10,368个同步的多视角场景。 在评估方面，我们使用来自21个身份的42个RenderMe-360（Pan et al., 2023）片段（每个身份2个片段），以及21个HDTF（Zhang et al., 2021）人像-音频对。 在两个数据集上的定量评估均使用25 fps的81帧片段。 尽管如此，我们支持任意长度的推理。 额外的野外场景和长序列演示已在项目页面提供。

paragraphs.en: Implementation details. Both stages use AdamW and bfloat16 on 8 NVIDIA RTX 6000 Ada GPUs (48 GB). Stage I fine-tunes the 1.3B StableAvatar model ( Tu et al., 2025 ) . Five-view adaptation uses a global batch size of eight for 6,800 updates with a peak learning rate of 5 × 10 − 4 5\times 10^{-4} . It generates five 416 × 608 416\times 608 videos using 30 sampling steps. Stage II fine-tunes FaceLift ( Lyu et al., 2025 ) for 7,328 updates with view-aware corruption, rear-prior distillation (weight 0.2 0.2 ), and active-volume regularization (weight 0.1 0.1 ). The default global batch size is 16, with a peak learning rate of 8 × 10 − 5 8\times 10^{-5} . Detailed training schedules and reproducibility settings are provided in the appendix.
paragraphs.zh: 实现细节。 两个阶段均在 8 块 NVIDIA RTX 6000 Ada GPU（48 GB）上使用 AdamW 和 bfloat16。 阶段 I 对 1.3B 的 StableAvatar 模型（Tu et al., 2025）进行微调。 五视角适配使用全局批大小 8，共进行 6,800 次更新，峰值学习率为 5 × 10 − 4 5\times 10^{-4}。 它使用 30 个采样步生成五个 416 × 608 416\times 608 的视频。 阶段 II 对 FaceLift（Lyu et al., 2025）进行微调，共 7,328 次更新，采用视角感知破坏、后视先验蒸馏（权重 0.2 0.2）和有效体积正则化（权重 0.1 0.1）。 默认全局批大小为 16，峰值学习率为 8 × 10 − 5 8\times 10^{-5}。 详细的训练日程和可复现性设置见附录。

paragraphs.en: Baselines. We compare with Real3D-Portrait ( Ye et al., 2024 ) , SDTalk ( Jia et al., 2026 ) , and NeRFFaceSpeech ( Kim et al., 2024 ) on RenderMe-360 and HDTF using released checkpoints and the same underlying reference portraits and speech segments. Because RenderMe-360 provides synchronized multi-view supervision, we compare both frontal and novel-view results on it; HDTF provides only frontal videos, so we report frontal comparisons only.
paragraphs.zh: 基线方法。 我们在 RenderMe-360 和 HDTF 上使用公开的模型权重以及相同的底层参考人像和语音片段，与 Real3D-Portrait（Ye 等，2024）、SDTalk（Jia 等，2026）和 NeRFFaceSpeech（Kim 等，2024）进行比较。 由于 RenderMe-360 提供同步的多视角监督，我们在其上同时比较正面视角和新视角的结果；HDTF 仅提供正面视频，因此我们只报告正面视角的比较结果。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation metrics. We report frontal PSNR, SSIM ( Wang et al., 2004 ) , LPIPS ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) , and FID ( Heusel et al., 2017 ) for appearance and reference-image ArcFace ( Deng et al., 2019 ) cosine similarity (CSIM-ref) for identity. Frontal appearance metrics use frames 1–80 after mapping every method to a common 512 × 512 512\times 512 white-background scoring canvas; Novel-view metrics use frame 0 at five unseen cameras on the same scoring canvas. Preprocessing, metric implementations, and aggregation rules are detailed in the appendix.
paragraphs.zh: 评估指标。 我们报告正面视角的 PSNR、SSIM（Wang et al., 2004）、LPIPS（Zhang et al., 2018）和 FID（Heusel et al., 2017）用于外观评估，并报告参考图像的 ArcFace（Deng et al., 2019）余弦相似度（CSIM-ref）用于身份评估。 正面外观指标是在将每个方法映射到统一的 512 × 512 512\times 512 白色背景评分画布后，使用第 1–80 帧进行计算；新视角指标是在同一评分画布上，使用第 0 帧在五个未见过的相机处进行计算。 预处理、指标实现以及聚合规则详见附录。

paragraphs.en: Comparison on RenderMe-360. Table 1 compares frontal-view and novel-view performance on RenderMe-360. The novel-view evaluation tests whether the reconstructed avatar generalizes from the frontal reference to non-frontal viewpoints. As shown in the table, our method achieves a substantially lower FID than all baselines (44.53 vs. 77.05–108.08), indicating that its generated videos better match the distribution of real videos. On the novel-view camera set, our method also achieves the best PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS among all baselines, demonstrating stronger generalization to non-frontal viewpoints.
paragraphs.zh: 在 RenderMe-360 上的比较。 表 1 比较了在 RenderMe-360 上正面视角和新视角的性能。 新视角评估检验重建的智能体能否从正面参考泛化到非正面视点。 如表所示，我们的方法取得了明显低于所有基线的 FID（44.53 对比 77.05–108.08），表明其生成的视频更接近真实视频的分布。 在新视角相机集合上，我们的方法在所有基线中也取得了最佳的 PSNR、SSIM 和 LPIPS，展示出对非正面视点更强的泛化能力。

paragraphs.en: Comparison on HDTF. Table 2 reports the frontal-only comparison on HDTF. It tests generalization to in-the-wild portraits and audio. We omit novel-view metrics because HDTF does not provide synchronized multi-camera ground truth. Our method obtains the best PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS, and FID while achieving CSIM-ref scores very close to the best-performing baseline (0.666 vs. 0.671). These results indicate that our method produces avatars with strong perceptual quality and rendered appearances that closely match the distribution of real-world face images.
paragraphs.zh: 在 HDTF 上的对比。 表 2 报告了在 HDTF 上仅正脸视角的对比结果。 它测试了对野外人像和音频的泛化能力。 我们省略了新视角指标，因为 HDTF 未提供同步的多相机真值。 我们的方法取得了最优的 PSNR、SSIM、LPIPS 和 FID，同时 CSIM-ref 分数非常接近表现最佳的基线方法（0.666 对比 0.671）。 这些结果表明，我们的方法生成的智能体具有出色的感知质量，其渲染外观与真实人脸图像的分布高度吻合。

paragraphs.en: Qualitative comparison. Figure 4 compares all methods’ multi-view consistency and geometric completeness of reconstructed avatars on RenderMe-360. Specifically, Real3D-Portrait shows head-neck separation as the viewpoint changes and fails to reconstruct a plausible back of the head. SDTalk shows artifacts across side views, inconsistent facial expressions when changing viewpoint, and blurred rear appearances. NeRFFaceSpeech exhibits distorted facial structures in non-frontal views. In contrast, our method maintains a coherent head shape and face-neck structure across viewpoints and reconstructs a plausible back of the head rather than blurred artifacts. These comparisons highlight the advantage of our method in reconstructing complete and multi-view-consistent avatars beyond just the frontal view. Beyond multi-view consistency, the RenderMe-360 and HDTF examples in Figure 5 highlight our method’s ability to preserve accessories and capture pronounced facial expressions. Specifically, while other methods omit parts of accessories, our method preserves them well. Our method also reproduces wide mouth openings more faithfully, whereas other methods show more restricted mouth openings. Video comparisons are provided on the project page.
paragraphs.zh: 定性比较。 图 4 比较了所有方法在 RenderMe-360 上重建的智能体（avatars）的多视角一致性与几何完整性。 具体而言，Real3D-Portrait 随视角变化出现头颈分离，且无法重建出合理的后脑勺。 SDTalk 在侧视角度出现伪影、视角变化时表情不一致，以及后部外观模糊。 NeRFFaceSpeech 在非正面视角下出现面部结构畸变。 相比之下，我们的方法在各视角下保持连贯的头部形状和面部—颈部结构，并重建出合理的后脑勺，而非模糊伪影。 这些比较凸显了我们的方法在重建完整且多视角一致的智能体方面的优势，而不仅限于正面视角。 除了多视角一致性之外，图 5 中的 RenderMe-360 和 HDTF 示例凸显了我们的方法保留配饰并捕捉明显面部表情的能力。 具体而言，其他方法会遗漏部分配饰，而我们的方法能很好地保留它们。 我们的方法还能更忠实地还原大张嘴的动作，而其他方法的张嘴幅度则更为受限。 视频比较见项目主页。

paragraphs.en: Stage I design choices. We evaluate the effect of adding a fifth frontal view to the downstream reconstruction inputs. Keeping the generated four-view inputs and reconstruction checkpoint fixed, we compare reconstruction with and without the additional frontal view. Figure 6 (a) shows that the fifth view produces sharper frontal reconstructions that more closely match the ground truth. Table 3 (a) also shows substantial improvements across all three metrics, confirming that the additional frontal view improves downstream reconstruction quality.
paragraphs.zh: 阶段 I 的设计选择。 我们评估在下游重建输入中增加第五个正面视角的效果。 在保持生成的四视角输入和重建检查点固定不变的情况下，我们比较了有与没有该额外正面视角时的重建结果。 图 6 (a) 表明，第五个视角能生成更清晰的正面重建结果，与真实值更加吻合。 表 3 (a) 还显示所有三项指标均有显著提升，证实了额外正面视角能改善下游重建质量。

sents.en: Stage I design choices.
sents.zh: 阶段 I 的设计选择。

sents.en: We evaluate the effect of adding a fifth frontal view to the downstream reconstruction inputs.
sents.zh: 我们评估在下游重建输入中增加第五个正面视角的效果。

sents.en: Keeping the generated four-view inputs and reconstruction checkpoint fixed, we compare reconstruction with and without the additional frontal view.
sents.zh: 在保持生成的四视角输入和重建检查点固定不变的情况下，我们比较了有与没有该额外正面视角时的重建结果。

sents.en: Figure 6 (a) shows that the fifth view produces sharper frontal reconstructions that more closely match the ground truth.
sents.zh: 图 6 (a) 表明，第五个视角能生成更清晰的正面重建结果，与真实值更加吻合。

sents.en: Table 3 (a) also shows substantial improvements across all three metrics, confirming that the additional frontal view improves downstream reconstruction quality.
sents.zh: 表 3 (a) 还显示所有三项指标均有显著提升，证实了额外正面视角能改善下游重建质量。

paragraphs.en: Stage II components. Figure 6 evaluates the contributions of view-aware corruption, active-volume regularization, and rear-prior distillation. Fine-tuning FaceLift on our data sharpens facial details. However, because the synthesized input views are not perfectly consistent ( Lyu et al., 2026a ) , direct fine-tuning can fit the observed cameras with 3D geometry that satisfies those views but does not remain correct from other viewpoints, producing floating structures around the head in side and rear renderings. Training with view-aware corruption removes most of these artifacts and produces a more compact reconstruction by teaching the model to reconcile inconsistencies across views. Nevertheless, some opaque Gaussians remain outside the spatial region expected to contain the head and upper body, as visible in the last row of the corruption result. Active-volume regularization suppresses these misplaced Gaussians and produces a cleaner, more compact reconstruction. Finally, rear-prior distillation improves the appearance of the back of the head. Together, these ablations show that each component addresses a distinct failure mode and contributes to the final reconstruction quality. Table 3 (b) provides quantitative results that further support the effectiveness of view-aware corruption.
paragraphs.zh: 第二阶段组件。 图6评估了视角感知破坏、主动体积正则化与后部先验蒸馏的贡献。 在我们的数据上微调FaceLift可以锐化面部细节。 然而，由于合成的输入视角并非完全一致（Lyu等人，2026a），直接微调可能使模型用满足这些观察相机视角的三维几何来拟合，但从其他视角看并不正确，导致在侧面和后部渲染中头部周围出现漂浮结构。 使用视角感知破坏进行训练通过教会模型调和跨视角的不一致性，去除了大部分这类伪影，并产生更紧凑的重建。 尽管如此，一些不透明的高斯仍然位于预期包含头部和上半身的空间区域之外，如破坏结果最后一行所示。 主动体积正则化抑制了这些错位的高斯，产生了更干净、更紧凑的重建。 最后，后部先验蒸馏改善了头部后部的外观。 总的来说，这些消融实验表明每个组件都解决了一种不同的失败模式，并对最终的重建质量有所贡献。 表3（b）提供的定量结果进一步支持了视角感知破坏的有效性。

paragraphs.en: We introduce AudioLift , a two-stage framework that generates a 3D talking avatar from a single portrait and audio, without a parametric face model or per-instance optimization. It jointly generates audio-driven multi-view video and reconstructs a full-head Gaussian avatar while accounting for inconsistencies among the generated views. Experiments on RenderMe-360 and HDTF, together with in-the-wild examples, show expressive facial motion, consistent novel-view rendering, and improved geometric completeness across a full 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} viewing range.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 AudioLift，这是一个两阶段框架，能够从单张肖像和音频生成 3D 说话智能体，无需参数化人脸模型或逐实例优化。 该方法联合生成音频驱动的多视角视频，并重建完整头部的 Gaussian 智能体，同时考虑所生成视角之间的不一致性。 在 RenderMe-360 和 HDTF 上的实验以及真实场景示例表明，该方法在完整的 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} 视角范围内实现了富有表现力的面部动作、一致的新视角渲染以及更高的几何完整性。

sents.en: We introduce AudioLift , a two-stage framework that generates a 3D talking avatar from a single portrait and audio, without a parametric face model or per-instance optimization.
sents.zh: 我们提出 AudioLift，这是一个两阶段框架，能够从单张肖像和音频生成 3D 说话智能体，无需参数化人脸模型或逐实例优化。

sents.en: Experiments on RenderMe-360 and HDTF, together with in-the-wild examples, show expressive facial motion, consistent novel-view rendering, and improved geometric completeness across a full 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} viewing range.
sents.zh: 在 RenderMe-360 和 HDTF 上的实验以及真实场景示例表明，该方法在完整的 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} 视角范围内实现了富有表现力的面部动作、一致的新视角渲染以及更高的几何完整性。

paragraphs.en: In this work, we used generative AI tools for implementation assistance on author-specified methods, translation of author-provided technical explanations into English, and feedback during discussions of evaluation procedures and result interpretation. The authors made the final experimental decisions and scientific judgments. We have not used generative AI tools for originating the core method or generating research datasets, and formal proof-related tasks are not applicable to this work. Additionally, we used generative AI tools for manuscript drafting and language refinement, table and LaTeX formatting, and identifying potentially relevant literature. Writing assistance helped organize and express author-provided technical content and findings, while literature suggestions served as candidates for subsequent review. We have reviewed all AI-assisted work. Specifically, AI-assisted code was manually inspected, suggested references were individually examined for relevance before inclusion, and AI-assisted text was checked and revised to accurately reflect the methods and findings. We take responsibility for the final content of this work, including text, claims or artifacts produced with the aid of generative AI.

paragraphs.en: Our work is intended for research on expressive 3D avatars and applications such as virtual communication and digital character animation. However, generating talking avatars from a single portrait and audio could enable unauthorized impersonation, fabricated speech, and misleading media. We advocate obtaining appropriate permissions for the use of personal likenesses and audio, clearly identifying generated content as synthetic, and avoiding deceptive or harmful applications. Our experiments use existing research datasets, and the sources, licenses, and attribution of additional in-the-wild assets are documented in the Appendix. Generated examples should not be interpreted as authentic recordings or statements by the depicted individuals.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的工作面向富有表现力的3D虚拟形象研究以及虚拟交流、数字角色动画等应用。 然而，从单张人像和音频生成说话虚拟形象可能会促成未经授权的身份冒充、伪造语音和误导性媒体内容。 我们主张在使用个人肖像和音频时获取适当许可，明确标识生成内容为合成内容，并避免欺骗性或有害的应用。 我们的实验使用现有研究数据集，额外获取的野外素材的来源、许可证和署名信息已在附录中记录。 生成的示例不应被解读为所描绘人物的真实录音或言论。

paragraphs.en: Our model architecture and training objectives are described in Section 3 , with additional implementation details in Appendices C and D . Appendix E specifies model initialization, training schedules, optimizer settings, random seeds, and inference configurations. Appendix F documents dataset construction, identity splits, preprocessing, and baseline generation. Appendix B details the evaluation cohorts, metric implementations, aggregation rules, and ablation protocols. Together, these descriptions provide the information needed to reproduce our training and evaluation procedures.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在第3节描述了模型架构和训练目标，并在附录C和D中提供了额外的实现细节。 附录E说明了模型初始化、训练计划、优化器设置、随机种子和推理配置。 附录F记录了数据集构建、身份划分、预处理和基线生成。 附录B详细描述了评估队列、指标实现、聚合规则和消融实验方案。 这些描述共同提供了复现我们训练和评估流程所需的信息。

sents.en: Our model architecture and training objectives are described in Section 3 , with additional implementation details in Appendices C and D .
sents.zh: 我们在第3节描述了模型架构和训练目标，并在附录C和D中提供了额外的实现细节。

sents.en: Appendix E specifies model initialization, training schedules, optimizer settings, random seeds, and inference configurations.
sents.zh: 附录E说明了模型初始化、训练计划、优化器设置、随机种子和推理配置。

sents.en: Appendix F documents dataset construction, identity splits, preprocessing, and baseline generation.
sents.zh: 附录F记录了数据集构建、身份划分、预处理和基线生成。

sents.en: Appendix B details the evaluation cohorts, metric implementations, aggregation rules, and ablation protocols.
sents.zh: 附录B详细描述了评估队列、指标实现、聚合规则和消融实验方案。

sents.en: Together, these descriptions provide the information needed to reproduce our training and evaluation procedures.
sents.zh: 这些描述共同提供了复现我们训练和评估流程所需的信息。

paragraphs.en: This appendix collects qualitative results on in-the-wild portraits: paintings, anime, stylized art, and photographs, driven by speech in English, Japanese, and Swahili. Frames in Sections A.1 and A.2 are selected by phoneme, that is, the clearest instance of each target sound among the frames where the audio is most certain. Alongside these selected frames, Table 4 reports an auxiliary mouth-opening measurement using automatically selected phoneme times across all 16 clips in the same curated set.
paragraphs.zh: 本附录收集了真实场景人像的定性结果：绘画、动漫、风格化艺术作品和照片，语音输入涵盖英语、日语和斯瓦希里语。 A.1 节和 A.2 节中的帧是按音素选取的，即在音频最确定的帧中，每个目标音最清晰的实例。 除了这些选定帧之外，表 4 还报告了一项辅助的嘴部张开程度测量，该测量使用自动选择的音素时刻，覆盖同一精选集合中的全部 16 个片段。

sents.zh: 本附录收集了真实场景人像的定性结果：绘画、动漫、风格化艺术作品和照片，语音输入涵盖英语、日语和斯瓦希里语。

sents.zh: 除了这些选定帧之外，表 4 还报告了一项辅助的嘴部张开程度测量，该测量使用自动选择的音素时刻，覆盖同一精选集合中的全部 16 个片段。

paragraphs.en: Across these examples the baselines animate the mouth far less than the audio asks for. The gap is clearest on open vowels: where the phoneme requires a wide opening, our method opens the mouth wide and closes it fully on the bilabial stops /m/ , /b/ , and /p/ , while the baselines hold a narrow, nearly constant aperture throughout. Table 4 quantifies exactly this contrast over all clips.
paragraphs.zh: 在这些示例中，基线方法的嘴部动画幅度远低于音频所要求的程度。 这种差距在开元音上最为明显：当音素要求张大开口时，我们的方法会将嘴张得很开，并在双唇塞音 /m/、/b/ 和 /p/ 上完全闭合，而基线方法在整个过程中保持狭窄且几乎恒定的开口度。 表 4 对所有片段中的这种对比进行了精确量化。

sents.zh: 在这些示例中，基线方法的嘴部动画幅度远低于音频所要求的程度。

sents.en: Table 4 quantifies exactly this contrast over all clips.
sents.zh: 表 4 对所有片段中的这种对比进行了精确量化。

paragraphs.en: Each strip follows one clip over a long window, so that identity, accessories, and background can be checked for drift across time rather than at a single instant.
paragraphs.zh: 每个条带对应同一个片段在较长时间窗口内的连续画面，因此可以检查身份、配饰和背景是否随时间发生漂移，而非仅在某一时刻进行检验。

paragraphs.en: Both clips below are driven by more than 20 seconds of audio (25 s of singing and 22.6 s of speech), well beyond the window seen during training, to show that quality and identity hold up over long inputs.
paragraphs.zh: 下面两个片段均由超过 20 秒的音频驱动（25 秒的歌声和 22.6 秒的语音），远超训练时所见的时间窗口，以展示质量和身份在长输入下依然保持稳定。

paragraphs.en: Each figure renders the same reconstruction from five azimuths at two time instants, one where the phoneme requires an open mouth and one where it requires closed lips. Identity, accessories, and the mouth shape stay consistent as the camera moves.
paragraphs.zh: 每幅图展示了在两个时间瞬间从五个方位角渲染的同一重建结果，其中一个瞬间音素需要张嘴，另一个瞬间需要闭唇。 随着相机移动，身份、配饰和嘴形保持一致。

sents.zh: 随着相机移动，身份、配饰和嘴形保持一致。

paragraphs.en: The in-the-wild results in this appendix and in the supplementary videos use sixteen image–audio pairs, listed in Table 5 . They come from a pool of 150 pairs that we assembled for qualitative comparison. We selected the sixteen pairs by visually inspecting our results, so they are not a random sample. None of the images or recordings belongs to our training data (NeRSemble) or to our evaluation sets (RenderMe-360 and HDTF).
paragraphs.zh: 本附录及补充视频中的真实场景结果使用了十六组图像–音频对，列于表5。 这些样本来自我们为定性比较而收集的150组对。 我们通过目视检查结果来挑选这十六组对，因此它们并非随机样本。 所有图像和录音均不属于我们的训练数据（NeRSemble）或我们的评估集（RenderMe-360和HDTF）。

paragraphs.en: Eight reference images are photographs from FFHQ, chosen by eye from a seeded random sample of 300 of its 70,000 images. The other eight come from Wikimedia Commons: five are photographs, two are public-domain paintings (Vincent van Gogh’s Self-Portrait of 1887 and Petrus Christus’s Portrait of a Young Woman ), and one is a public-domain AI-generated illustration. We searched Commons by keyword and kept only public-domain, CC0, CC BY, and CC BY-SA files. For the photographs and the Christus portrait, we also required a portrait-oriented image with exactly one detected face whose center lies in the upper half of the frame, so that the upper body is visible. We rejected images that show a second person or whose matte damages the hair or accessories. Each image is prepared like our training references. Robust Video Matting removes the background, except for the van Gogh painting and the AI-generated illustration, which use rembg with U 2 -Net. The foreground is composited onto white and framed to 832 × 1216 832\times 1216 from MediaPipe face landmarks. The baselines receive the same square input as in Appendix F.1 : the crop ( 0,191,832 , 1023 ) (0,191,832,1023) of the 832 × 1216 832\times 1216 reference, stored as an 832 × 832 832\times 832 JPEG at quality 95.
paragraphs.zh: 八张参考图像是来自 FFHQ 的照片，从其 70,000 张图像中通过固定随机种子抽样 300 张后人工挑选而得。 另外八张来自 Wikimedia Commons：五张是照片，两张是公有领域画作（文森特·梵高的 1887 年《自画像》和彼得鲁斯·克里斯图斯的《年轻女子肖像》），还有一张是公有领域的 AI 生成插画。 我们通过关键词在 Commons 上搜索，只保留了公有领域、CC0、CC BY 和 CC BY-SA 许可的文件。 对于照片和克里斯图斯的肖像，我们还要求图像为竖向构图，且恰好检测到一张人脸、其中心位于画框上半部，以使上半身可见。 我们排除了出现第二个人的图像，以及抠图（matte）损坏头发或配饰的图像。 每张图像都按照我们的训练参考图像相同的方式进行处理。 除梵高画作和 AI 生成插画使用带 U 2 -Net 的 rembg 外，其余图像均使用 Robust Video Matting 去除背景。 前景合成到白色背景上，并依据 MediaPipe 面部关键点裁剪为 832 × 1216 832\times 1216 的画框。 基线方法接收与附录 F.1 中相同的方形输入：832 × 1216 832\times 1216 参考图像的裁剪区域 ( 0,191,832 , 1023 ) (0,191,832,1023)，以质量 95 保存为 832 × 832 832\times 832 的 JPEG 文件。

sents.zh: 八张参考图像是来自 FFHQ 的照片，从其 70,000 张图像中通过固定随机种子抽样 300 张后人工挑选而得。

paragraphs.en: All voices are real recordings from public speech and singing corpora: six LibriSpeech test-clean utterances of English read speech, two FLEURS utterances of Swahili and French read speech, five GTSinger songs sung in English, Italian, German, and Japanese, and three Expresso utterances of English speech read in enunciated, sad, and happy styles. Each GTSinger recording concatenates, in order, the plain-technique phrases of one song. All recordings are resampled to 16 kHz mono and peak-normalized to − 1 -1 dBFS, with no time-stretching or voice conversion. Voices were assigned to images by a random draw with a fixed seed that matches the voice’s gender to the apparent gender of the depicted person. Every face therefore speaks with another person’s voice, and no video shows real speech by the person depicted.
paragraphs.zh: 所有语音均来自公开语音与歌唱语料库的真实录音：六条来自 LibriSpeech test-clean 的英语朗读语音语句、两条来自 FLEURS 的斯瓦希里语和法语朗读语音语句、五首来自 GTSinger 的英语、意大利语、德语和日语歌曲，以及三条来自 Expresso 的分别以清晰、悲伤和欢快风格朗读的英语语音语句。 每条 GTSinger 录音按顺序拼接了一首歌曲的普通技巧乐句。 所有录音均重采样为 16 kHz 单声道并进行峰值归一化至 −1 dBFS，没有任何时间拉伸或声音转换。 语音与图像的匹配是通过固定随机种子的随机抽取完成的，使语音的性别与所描绘人物的外表性别相符。 因此，每张人脸都在用他人的声音说话，并且没有任何视频展示所描绘人物的真实说话内容。

paragraphs.en: Recordings of up to 13.5 s are used in full. Longer recordings are cut near 10–13 s, which gives clips of 9.7–12.6 s. Songs end with their first phrase as segmented in GTSinger, and speech ends at a sentence pause located by silence detection. All methods receive the same audio file. Two long-sequence examples use longer audio: the full 22.6-s recording of clip 014 and the first 25.0 s of clip 090.
paragraphs.zh: 长达 13.5 秒的录音被完整使用。 更长的录音在接近 10–13 秒处截断，得到 9.7–12.6 秒的片段。 歌曲以 GTSinger 中切分出的第一个乐句作为结尾，语音则在通过静音检测定位的句子停顿处结束。 所有方法接收相同的音频文件。 两个长序列示例使用了更长的音频：片段 014 的完整 22.6 秒录音，以及片段 090 的前 25.0 秒。

Every method receives the same underlying reference portrait and 3.24-second, 16-kHz mono speech segment for a clip, with method-specific input preprocessing. Generated videos contain 81 frames at 25 fps. Both sessions use the source interval from 5.00 to 8.24 seconds. At the source rate of 30 fps, output frame t t uses raw frame 150 + round ⁡ ( 30 ​ t / 25 ) 150+\operatorname{round}(30t/25) for t = 0 , … , 80 t=0,\ldots,80 . The reference portrait comes from source-camera frame 150, the first frame of this selected window, not the beginning of the recording.

The same 21-subject subset is used for every method and every reported HDTF metric. Table 6 summarizes the temporal windows used for training and external evaluation. Every window contains 3.24 seconds of 16-kHz mono audio (51,840 samples) and 81 video frames at 25 fps. The nominal frame times relative to the window start are 0 , 0.04 , … , 3.20 0,0.04,\ldots,3.20 seconds; the audio spans the full 3.24-second window.
paragraphs.zh: HDTF 为 21 位受试者每人使用一对肖像–音频：AnnMarieBuerkle、AnnWagner、AustinScott0、BillCassidy、BobCorker、BobbySchilling、CandiceMiller、CarlyFiorina0、CathyMcMorrisRodgers0、ChuckGrassley、CoryGardner、DanNewhouse、DanSullivan、DaveCamp、DavidVitter、DeanHeller、DebFischer0、DianeBlack0、DuncanHunter、ErikPaulsen 和 FredUpton。 相同的 21 人子集被用于所有方法以及所有报告的 HDTF 指标。 表 6 汇总了用于训练和外部评估的时间窗口。 每个窗口包含 3.24 秒的 16 kHz 单声道音频（51,840 个采样点）以及 25 fps 下的 81 帧视频。 相对于窗口起始的标称帧时刻为 0,0.04,\ldots,3.20 秒；音频则覆盖完整的 3.24 秒窗口。

sents.en: Table 6 summarizes the temporal windows used for training and external evaluation.
sents.zh: 表 6 汇总了用于训练和外部评估的时间窗口。

sents.en: Every window contains 3.24 seconds of 16-kHz mono audio (51,840 samples) and 81 video frames at 25 fps.
sents.zh: 每个窗口包含 3.24 秒的 16 kHz 单声道音频（51,840 个采样点）以及 25 fps 下的 81 帧视频。

sents.en: The nominal frame times relative to the window start are 0 , 0.04 , … , 3.20 0,0.04,\ldots,3.20 seconds; the audio spans the full 3.24-second window.
sents.zh: 相对于窗口起始的标称帧时刻为 0,0.04,\ldots,3.20 秒；音频则覆盖完整的 3.24 秒窗口。

paragraphs.en: For HDTF, we first select a reference-verified, single-speaker window within the official target-speaker intervals, favoring acoustically homogeneous segments without shot changes. Within this window, we take the beginning of the first pause-delimited speech segment lasting at least 3.24 seconds. Speech segments are detected from 20-ms audio-energy measurements, with pauses of at least 0.35 seconds separating them. If no segment is long enough, we start from the longest available segment and move the start earlier if needed to keep the full 3.24 seconds inside the selected window. This fallback can cross a pause and is used for two of the 21 clips. The reference portrait is verified against the target speaker but need not come from the evaluation window’s first frame. Window selection is based on source material, not generated videos, and the chosen reference and audio are shared by all methods.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 HDTF，我们首先在官方目标说话人区间内选择一个经过参考验证的单一说话人窗口，优先选择声学上同质且没有镜头切换的片段。 在该窗口内，我们取第一个由停顿分隔、且持续至少 3.24 秒的语音片段的开头。 语音片段通过 20 毫秒的音频能量测量来检测，片段之间以至少 0.35 秒的停顿分隔。 如果没有足够长的片段，我们从最长的可用片段开始，并在必要时将起点前移，以使完整的 3.24 秒保持在所选窗口之内。 这种回退方式可能跨越一个停顿，在 21 个片段中有 2 个使用了这种方式。 参考人像经过对目标说话人的验证，但不必来自评估窗口的第一帧。 窗口选择基于源素材而非生成的视频，且所选的参考和音频由所有方法共享。

sents.zh: 在该窗口内，我们取第一个由停顿分隔、且持续至少 3.24 秒的语音片段的开头。

sents.en: Speech segments are detected from 20-ms audio-energy measurements, with pauses of at least 0.35 seconds separating them.
sents.zh: 语音片段通过 20 毫秒的音频能量测量来检测，片段之间以至少 0.35 秒的停顿分隔。

sents.en: If no segment is long enough, we start from the longest available segment and move the start earlier if needed to keep the full 3.24 seconds inside the selected window.
sents.zh: 如果没有足够长的片段，我们从最长的可用片段开始，并在必要时将起点前移，以使完整的 3.24 秒保持在所选窗口之内。

sents.en: This fallback can cross a pause and is used for two of the 21 clips.
sents.zh: 这种回退方式可能跨越一个停顿，在 21 个片段中有 2 个使用了这种方式。

sents.en: The reference portrait is verified against the target speaker but need not come from the evaluation window’s first frame.
sents.zh: 参考人像经过对目标说话人的验证，但不必来自评估窗口的第一帧。

sents.en: Window selection is based on source material, not generated videos, and the chosen reference and audio are shared by all methods.
sents.zh: 窗口选择基于源素材而非生成的视频，且所选的参考和音频由所有方法共享。

paragraphs.en: To pair HDTF predictions with GT, we sample the source timeline at 25 fps from the chosen audio start: output frame t t corresponds to t / 25 t/25 seconds after that start. We use the decoded source video frame with the nearest timestamp, choosing the earlier one on ties. Audio start times are relative to the first decoded audio sample, accounting for any offset between the audio and video streams rather than assuming that the container timestamp is their common origin. We do not shift or retime a prediction to improve its agreement with GT.
paragraphs.zh: 为了将 HDTF 预测与 GT 配对，我们从选定的音频起点开始以 25 fps 对源时间轴进行采样：输出第 t 帧对应于该起点之后 t / 25 秒。 我们使用时间戳最接近的已解码源视频帧，若时间戳相同则选择较早的一帧。 音频起始时间是相对于第一个已解码音频样本的，并考虑音频流与视频流之间的任何偏移，而不是假设容器时间戳是它们的共同原点。 我们不会为了提升预测与 GT 的一致性而对预测进行平移或重新定时。

sents.en: To pair HDTF predictions with GT, we sample the source timeline at 25 fps from the chosen audio start: output frame t t corresponds to t / 25 t/25 seconds after that start.
sents.zh: 为了将 HDTF 预测与 GT 配对，我们从选定的音频起点开始以 25 fps 对源时间轴进行采样：输出第 t 帧对应于该起点之后 t / 25 秒。

sents.en: We use the decoded source video frame with the nearest timestamp, choosing the earlier one on ties.
sents.zh: 我们使用时间戳最接近的已解码源视频帧，若时间戳相同则选择较早的一帧。

sents.en: Audio start times are relative to the first decoded audio sample, accounting for any offset between the audio and video streams rather than assuming that the container timestamp is their common origin.
sents.zh: 音频起始时间是相对于第一个已解码音频样本的，并考虑音频流与视频流之间的任何偏移，而不是假设容器时间戳是它们的共同原点。

sents.en: We do not shift or retime a prediction to improve its agreement with GT.
sents.zh: 我们不会为了提升预测与 GT 的一致性而对预测进行平移或重新定时。

paragraphs.en: For both datasets, we exclude frame 0 because it is the reference-conditioned anchor rather than an ordinary audio-driven frame; including this easier frame can inflate the clip mean. We apply the same exclusion to every method. For each remaining frame t ∈ { 1 , … , 80 } t\in\{1,\ldots,80\} , we compare the predicted frontal output with the ground-truth observation at the corresponding time: camera 25 on RenderMe-360 and the source video on HDTF. Each method therefore contributes 42 × 80 = 3,360 42\times 80=3{,}360 paired frontal comparisons on RenderMe-360 and 21 × 80 = 1,680 21\times 80=1{,}680 on HDTF.
paragraphs.zh: 对于这两个数据集，我们都排除第 0 帧，因为它是以参考为条件的锚定帧，而不是普通的音频驱动帧；纳入这个更容易的帧会虚高片段均值。 我们对所有方法采用相同的排除方式。 对于其余每一帧 t ∈ { 1 , … , 80 } t\in\{1,\ldots,80\}，我们将预测的正面输出与相应时刻的真值观测进行比较：在 RenderMe-360 上为相机 25，在 HDTF 上为源视频。 因此，每种方法在 RenderMe-360 上贡献 42 × 80 = 3,360 42\times 80=3{,}360 组成对的正面比较，在 HDTF 上贡献 21 × 80 = 1,680 21\times 80=1{,}680 组。

sents.en: All methods use the same frame indices, ground truth, scoring resolution, and metric implementation.
sents.zh: 所有方法使用相同的帧索引、真值、评分分辨率和指标实现。

sents.en: Their native outputs require different deterministic mappings to the common 512 × 512 512\times 512 RGB canvas:
sents.zh: 它们的原生输出需要经过不同的确定性映射，转换到统一的 512 × 512 512\times 512 RGB 画布上：

paragraphs.en: For our method, the evaluated video is the frontal rendering of the final Stage-II reconstructed avatar, not the intermediate Stage-I frontal video. We crop the portrait with ( x 0 , y 0 , x 1 , y 1 ) = ( 0,191,832 , 1023 ) (x_{0},y_{0},x_{1},y_{1})=(0,191,832,1023) , obtaining an 832 × 832 832\times 832 square, and resize it to 512 × 512 512\times 512 with Pillow Lanczos. Real3D-Portrait and SDTalk already produce 512 × 512 512\times 512 videos. NeRFFaceSpeech uses its released face-alignment preprocessing with the largest detected source face selected consistently for all inputs. Its decoded 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 output is resized directly to 512 × 512 512\times 512 ; we do not invert its face alignment or fit the output to the GT framing. Thus a common scoring resolution does not imply pixel-aligned facial crops across methods. Frontal scores use decoded native videos, not annotated figures, side-by-side previews, or intermediate Stage-I outputs.
paragraphs.zh: 对于我们的方法，被评估的视频是最终第二阶段重建的智能体的正面渲染结果，而非中间的第一阶段正面视频。 我们使用 ( x 0 , y 0 , x 1 , y 1 ) = (0, 191, 832, 1024) 对人像进行裁剪，得到 832 × 832 的正方形，并用 Pillow Lanczos 将其缩放至 512 × 512。 Real3D-Portrait 和 SDTalk 本身就生成 512 × 512 的视频。 NeRFFaceSpeech 使用其发布的人脸对齐预处理流程，并对所有输入一致地选取检测到的最大源人脸。 其解码出的 1024 × 1024 输出被直接缩放至 512 × 512；我们不对其人脸对齐进行求逆，也不将输出拟合到真值的取景范围。 因此，统一的评分分辨率并不意味着各方法之间的人脸裁剪在像素上对齐。 正面评分使用解码后的原生视频，而非标注图、并排预览图或中间的第一阶段输出。

sents.en: For our method, the evaluated video is the frontal rendering of the final Stage-II reconstructed avatar, not the intermediate Stage-I frontal video.
sents.zh: 对于我们的方法，被评估的视频是最终第二阶段重建的智能体的正面渲染结果，而非中间的第一阶段正面视频。

sents.zh: 我们使用 ( x 0 , y 0 , x 1 , y 1 ) = (0, 191, 832, 1024) 对人像进行裁剪，得到 832 × 832 的正方形，并用 Pillow Lanczos 将其缩放至 512 × 512。

sents.zh: Real3D-Portrait 和 SDTalk 本身就生成 512 × 512 的视频。

sents.en: NeRFFaceSpeech uses its released face-alignment preprocessing with the largest detected source face selected consistently for all inputs.
sents.zh: NeRFFaceSpeech 使用其发布的人脸对齐预处理流程，并对所有输入一致地选取检测到的最大源人脸。

sents.en: Its decoded 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 output is resized directly to 512 × 512 512\times 512 ; we do not invert its face alignment or fit the output to the GT framing.
sents.zh: 其解码出的 1024 × 1024 输出被直接缩放至 512 × 512；我们不对其人脸对齐进行求逆，也不将输出拟合到真值的取景范围。

sents.en: Thus a common scoring resolution does not imply pixel-aligned facial crops across methods.
sents.zh: 因此，统一的评分分辨率并不意味着各方法之间的人脸裁剪在像素上对齐。

sents.en: Frontal scores use decoded native videos, not annotated figures, side-by-side previews, or intermediate Stage-I outputs.
sents.zh: 正面评分使用解码后的原生视频，而非标注图、并排预览图或中间的第一阶段输出。

paragraphs.en: For RenderMe-360 GT, we transform raw camera-25 RGB and the official soft foreground mask independently using the same clip-fixed portrait window, white RGB padding and zero alpha padding, Lanczos resizing to 832 × 1216 832\times 1216 , the square crop above, and Lanczos resizing to 512 × 512 512\times 512 . Only then do we composite GT once over white. For uint8 RGB C C and alpha a a , the stored value is ⌊ ( C ​ a + 255 ​ ( 255 − a ) + 127 ) / 255 ⌋ \lfloor(Ca+255(255-a)+127)/255\rfloor , with alpha broadcast over channels. HDTF follows the same fixed-window and square-crop procedure but uses an estimated GT alpha from Robust Video Matting (ResNet-50), not an official dataset mask. Its recurrent state is reset per clip and advanced over all 81 selected source frames, with downsampling ratio min ⁡ ( 512 / max ⁡ ( W , H ) , 1 ) \min(512/\max(W,H),1) on the raw source image. We retain raw GT RGB, quantize the predicted alpha to uint8, transform RGB and alpha separately, and composite once at 512 × 512 512\times 512 . Framing is fixed from the anchor and does not track the generated face.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 RenderMe-360 GT，我们使用相同的固定于片段的人像窗口、白色 RGB 填充和零 alpha 填充、Lanczos 缩放至 832 × 1216、上述方形裁剪以及 Lanczos 缩放至 512 × 512，独立地对原始 camera-25 RGB 和官方软前景掩码进行变换。 只有在此之后，我们才将 GT 在白色背景上合成一次。 对于 uint8 的 RGB 通道 C 和 alpha a，存储的值为 ⌊(C a + 255 (255 − a) + 127) / 255⌋，其中 alpha 沿通道广播。 HDTF 遵循相同的固定窗口和方形裁剪流程，但使用由 Robust Video Matting（ResNet-50）估计的 GT alpha，而非官方数据集掩码。 其循环状态在每个片段重置，并在全部 81 帧选定的源帧上前向推进，在原始源图像上的下采样比率为 min(512 / max(W, H), 1)。 我们保留原始 GT RGB，将预测的 alpha 量化为 uint8，分别变换 RGB 和 alpha，并在 512 × 512 时合成一次。 取景由锚点固定，不追踪生成的人脸。

paragraphs.en: SDTalk’s native black background is normalized using a fixed BiRefNet-matting model applied only to its prediction. The RGB input is bilinearly resized to 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 and ImageNet-normalized; the final sigmoid matte is converted to uint8 and bicubically resized to 512 × 512 512\times 512 . Given native RGB P P and estimated alpha a ^ \hat{a} , the scored prediction is clip ⁡ ( P + 255 − a ^ , 0 , 255 ) \operatorname{clip}(P+255-\hat{a},0,255) , with the addition performed before conversion to uint8. This is an approximate black-to-white replacement, not recovered renderer alpha. The model and rule are shared across clips and views, without GT masks, thresholding, morphological corrections, or per-example tuning. Errors in this external matte remain in the scored images. It is not applied to CSIM-ref videos. For all methods, predictions are not masked with GT alpha or spatially aligned to each GT frame; PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS, and FID use the whole resulting canvas. This differs from the earlier jointly GT-masked scoring variant.
paragraphs.zh: SDTalk 原生的黑色背景仅在其预测结果上使用固定的 BiRefNet 抠图模型进行归一化。 RGB 输入被双线性缩放到 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 并做 ImageNet 归一化；最终的 sigmoid 抠图被转换为 uint8 并三次插值缩放到 512 × 512 512\times 512。 给定原生 RGB 图像 P P 和估计的 alpha 通道 a ^ \hat{a}，参与评分的预测结果为 clip ⁡ ( P + 255 − a ^ , 0 , 255 ) \operatorname{clip}(P+255-\hat{a},0,255)，其中加法在转换为 uint8 之前进行。 这是一种近似的黑底换白底操作，并非恢复渲染器的 alpha 通道。 该模型和规则在所有片段和视角间共享，不使用 GT 掩码、阈值处理、形态学修正或针对单个样本的调优。 该外部抠图中的误差会保留在参与评分的图像中。 该处理不应用于 CSIM-ref 视频。 对于所有方法，预测结果均不使用 GT alpha 进行掩码处理，也不与各 GT 帧进行空间对齐；PSNR、SSIM、LPIPS 和 FID 均在整个输出画布上计算。 这与此前联合使用 GT 掩码进行评分的版本有所不同。

paragraphs.en: CSIM-ref compares each generated face with the reference image actually consumed by that method, rather than with a time-matched GT frame; on HDTF, all methods are compared with the same 832 × 1216 832\times 1216 reference portrait, of which the baselines’ square input is a crop. It uses native decoded frames before the common-canvas conversion and evaluates frames 1–80. RGB images are converted to BGR and passed to InsightFace FaceAnalysis with the buffalo_l model, CPU execution, and detector input size ( 320,320 ) (320,320) instead of the library default ( 640,640 ) (640,640) . For each frame, we compute CSIM using the largest detected face. The returned normed_embedding is explicitly L2-normalized once more.
paragraphs.zh: CSIM-ref 将每个生成的人脸与该方法实际使用的参考图像进行比较，而不是与时间对齐的真值（GT）帧比较；在 HDTF 上，所有方法均与相同的 832 × 1216 832\times 1216 参考人像进行比较，各基线方法的方形输入即为其裁剪。 它使用公共画布转换前的原始解码帧，并评估第 1–80 帧。 RGB 图像被转换为 BGR，并传入使用 buffalo_l 模型的 InsightFace FaceAnalysis，采用 CPU 执行，检测器输入尺寸为 ( 320,320 ) (320,320)，而非库默认的 ( 640,640 ) (640,640)。 对每一帧，我们使用检测到的最大人脸计算 CSIM。 返回的 normed_embedding 会被再次显式地进行 L2 归一化。

sents.en: CSIM-ref compares each generated face with the reference image actually consumed by that method, rather than with a time-matched GT frame; on HDTF, all methods are compared with the same 832 × 1216 832\times 1216 reference portrait, of which the baselines’ square input is a crop.
sents.zh: CSIM-ref 将每个生成的人脸与该方法实际使用的参考图像进行比较，而不是与时间对齐的真值（GT）帧比较；在 HDTF 上，所有方法均与相同的 832 × 1216 832\times 1216 参考人像进行比较，各基线方法的方形输入即为其裁剪。

sents.en: It uses native decoded frames before the common-canvas conversion and evaluates frames 1–80.
sents.zh: 它使用公共画布转换前的原始解码帧，并评估第 1–80 帧。

sents.en: RGB images are converted to BGR and passed to InsightFace FaceAnalysis with the buffalo_l model, CPU execution, and detector input size ( 320,320 ) (320,320) instead of the library default ( 640,640 ) (640,640) .
sents.zh: RGB 图像被转换为 BGR，并传入使用 buffalo_l 模型的 InsightFace FaceAnalysis，采用 CPU 执行，检测器输入尺寸为 ( 320,320 ) (320,320)，而非库默认的 ( 640,640 ) (640,640)。

sents.en: For each frame, we compute CSIM using the largest detected face.
sents.zh: 对每一帧，我们使用检测到的最大人脸计算 CSIM。

sents.en: The returned normed_embedding is explicitly L2-normalized once more.
sents.zh: 返回的 normed_embedding 会被再次显式地进行 L2 归一化。

paragraphs.en: The detector input size only sets the resolution at which the detector searches for faces; the detection threshold ( 0.5 0.5 ), the five-landmark alignment to a 112 × 112 112\times 112 crop, and the recognition network are unchanged. It matters only for faces that fill most of the frame, such as NeRFFaceSpeech’s 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 face-aligned outputs, especially in side views: at ( 640,640 ) (640,640) these faces are scored below the threshold and dropped, whereas at ( 320,320 ) (320,320) the same faces are detected. Because a smaller input size could in principle admit a wrong detection, we keep scoring only the largest detected face in each frame. We verified on the same RenderMe-360 videos (four methods, seven views, 42 clips) that the change is safe. No face detected at ( 640,640 ) (640,640) is lost at ( 320,320 ) (320,320) , and where both settings detect a face, the selected boxes overlap with an IoU of at least 0.6 0.6 in every frame ( 0.94 0.94 on average), so the same face is scored. Because the facial landmarks used for alignment shift slightly between the two input sizes, individual frame scores fluctuate slightly, but the fluctuations are equally likely to go up or down and cancel out: the final scores of Ours, Real3D-Portrait, and SDTalk change by at most 0.003 0.003 , and the conclusions are unaffected. The only substantive effect is that 6,508 NeRFFaceSpeech frames missed at ( 640,640 ) (640,640) are now scored, which is desired.
paragraphs.zh: 检测器的输入尺寸只决定了检测器搜索人脸的分辨率；检测阈值（0.5）、对齐到 112 × 112 裁剪区域的五个关键点对齐以及识别网络均保持不变。 它只在人脸占据画面大部分的情况下才有影响，例如 NeRFFaceSpeech 的 1024 × 1024 人脸对齐输出，尤其是在侧视角度下：在 (640, 640) 时这些人脸的得分低于阈值而被丢弃，而在 (320, 320) 时同样的人脸则能被检测到。 由于较小的输入尺寸原则上可能引入错误的检测，我们仍只对每帧中检测到的最大人脸进行评分。 我们在相同的 RenderMe-360 视频上（四种方法、七个视角、42 个片段）验证了这一改动是安全的。 在 (640, 640) 下检测到的任何人脸都不会在 (320, 320) 下丢失，并且在两种设置都检测到人脸的地方，所选框在每一帧中的 IoU 至少为 0.6（平均为 0.94），因此评分的是同一张人脸。 由于用于对齐的人脸关键点在两种输入尺寸之间会有轻微偏移，个别帧的得分会略有波动，但这些波动上升或下降的概率相等并相互抵消：Ours、Real3D-Portrait 和 SDTalk 的最终得分变化至多为 0.003，结论不受影响。 唯一的实质性影响是，在 (640, 640) 下漏检的 6,508 个 NeRFFaceSpeech 帧现在得到了评分，这正是我们所期望的。

paragraphs.en: We report a multi-view CSIM-ref. In addition to the frontal video, each method renders the same audio-driven sequence with the camera rotated by ± 20 ∘ \pm 20^{\circ} , ± 40 ∘ \pm 40^{\circ} , and ± 60 ∘ \pm 60^{\circ} of yaw about the head at unchanged elevation, using each method’s own camera convention, giving seven 81-frame talking videos per clip. Valid frame scores are averaged within each video, and the clip value is the equal-weight mean of the seven per-view means. On RenderMe-360, clip values are averaged over the two sessions per identity and then over the 21 identities with equal weight; on HDTF, they are averaged over the 21 selected subjects.
paragraphs.zh: 我们报告一个多视角 CSIM-ref。 除了正面视频外，每种方法还使用其自身的相机约定，在仰角不变的情况下，将相机绕头部旋转偏航角 ± 20 ∘ \pm 20^{\circ}、± 40 ∘ \pm 40^{\circ} 和 ± 60 ∘ \pm 60^{\circ}，渲染同一段音频驱动的序列，从而每个片段得到七个 81 帧的说话视频。 有效帧的分数在每个视频内取平均，片段值则是七个视角均值的等权平均。 在 RenderMe-360 上，片段值先在每个身份的两个会话上取平均，再对 21 个身份等权取平均；在 HDTF 上，则对 21 个选定对象取平均。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate novel-view fidelity at anchor frame 0 using RenderMe-360 cameras 22, 28, 23, 26, and 29. For each of the 42 clips, a method’s rendering at each registered target camera is paired with the simultaneous GT observation from that camera, giving 42 × 5 = 210 42\times 5=210 image pairs per evaluated method. The comparison includes all four methods: ours, Real3D-Portrait, SDTalk, and NeRFFaceSpeech. Camera 25 is the source-camera diagnostic and is not one of these five targets; other rendered camera groups are not pooled into this table entry.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在锚点帧 0 上使用 RenderMe-360 的相机 22、28、23、26 和 29 评价新视角保真度。 对于 42 个片段中的每一个，将某个方法在每个已注册目标相机上的渲染结果与该相机同时刻的真实值（GT）观测配对，从而为每个被评估方法得到 42 × 5 = 210 42\times 5=210 个图像对。 该比较包含全部四种方法：我们的方法、Real3D-Portrait、SDTalk 和 NeRFFaceSpeech。 相机 25 是源相机诊断用途，不属于这五个目标之一；其他渲染的相机组不会被合并到本表格项中。

Method-level calibration choices and the fixed adapters are specified in Appendix F.2 ; target crop windows remain fixed across methods. paragraphs.en: Table 3 (a) fixes the final five-view Stage-I generator, its four synthesized grid views, and the released, frozen FaceLift reconstructor. The five-view condition adds the frontal output of that same generator; it does not add a GT image or use a separately trained generator. We score the resulting reconstructions from frontal camera 222200037 at frames 0–80, giving 8 × 81 = 648 8\times 81=648 image pairs per condition. The archived prediction videos were encoded from 416 × 608 416\times 608 renders, and GT was Lanczos-downsampled from 832 × 1216 832\times 1216 to the same size; both use H.264, CRF 10, yuv420p , and 25 fps. We decode the archives to RGB and pair frames by index, using OpenCV Lanczos4 to resize a prediction to the GT dimensions only if needed. No temporal or facial registration is performed. The PSNR column is foreground-only : its MSE uses RGB errors at GT pixels satisfying R + G + B < 735 R+G+B<735 in the decoded white-background image. SSIM and LPIPS use the entire image, not this foreground mask.
paragraphs.zh: 表 3 (a) 固定了最终的五视角 Stage-I 生成器、其合成的四个网格视角，以及已发布的冻结版 FaceLift 重建器。 五视角条件仅增加了同一生成器的正面输出；它并未添加 GT 图像，也未使用单独训练的生成器。 我们从正面相机 222200037 在第 0–80 帧对所得重建结果进行评分，每种条件得到 8 × 81 = 648 8\times 81=648 组图像对。 归档的预测视频由 416 × 608 416\times 608 渲染结果编码而来，GT 则由 832 × 1216 832\times 1216 经 Lanczos 降采样至相同尺寸；两者均采用 H.264、CRF 10、yuv420p 以及 25 fps。 我们将归档解码为 RGB 并按索引配对帧，仅在需要时使用 OpenCV 的 Lanczos4 将预测图像调整为 GT 的尺寸。 不执行任何时间或面部配准。 PSNR 列仅针对前景：其 MSE 使用解码后的白色背景图像中满足 R + G + B < 735 R+G+B<735 的 GT 像素处的 RGB 误差。 SSIM 和 LPIPS 使用整幅图像，而非该前景掩码。

sents.en: Table 3 (a) fixes the final five-view Stage-I generator, its four synthesized grid views, and the released, frozen FaceLift reconstructor.
sents.zh: 表 3 (a) 固定了最终的五视角 Stage-I 生成器、其合成的四个网格视角，以及已发布的冻结版 FaceLift 重建器。

sents.en: The five-view condition adds the frontal output of that same generator; it does not add a GT image or use a separately trained generator.
sents.zh: 五视角条件仅增加了同一生成器的正面输出；它并未添加 GT 图像，也未使用单独训练的生成器。

sents.en: We score the resulting reconstructions from frontal camera 222200037 at frames 0–80, giving 8 × 81 = 648 8\times 81=648 image pairs per condition.
sents.zh: 我们从正面相机 222200037 在第 0–80 帧对所得重建结果进行评分，每种条件得到 8 × 81 = 648 8\times 81=648 组图像对。

sents.en: The archived prediction videos were encoded from 416 × 608 416\times 608 renders, and GT was Lanczos-downsampled from 832 × 1216 832\times 1216 to the same size; both use H.264, CRF 10, yuv420p , and 25 fps.
sents.zh: 归档的预测视频由 416 × 608 416\times 608 渲染结果编码而来，GT 则由 832 × 1216 832\times 1216 经 Lanczos 降采样至相同尺寸；两者均采用 H.264、CRF 10、yuv420p 以及 25 fps。

sents.en: We decode the archives to RGB and pair frames by index, using OpenCV Lanczos4 to resize a prediction to the GT dimensions only if needed.
sents.zh: 我们将归档解码为 RGB 并按索引配对帧，仅在需要时使用 OpenCV 的 Lanczos4 将预测图像调整为 GT 的尺寸。

sents.en: No temporal or facial registration is performed.
sents.zh: 不执行任何时间或面部配准。

sents.en: The PSNR column is foreground-only : its MSE uses RGB errors at GT pixels satisfying R + G + B < 735 R+G+B<735 in the decoded white-background image.
sents.zh: PSNR 列仅针对前景：其 MSE 使用解码后的白色背景图像中满足 R + G + B < 735 R+G+B<735 的 GT 像素处的 RGB 误差。

sents.en: SSIM and LPIPS use the entire image, not this foreground mask.
sents.zh: SSIM 和 LPIPS 使用整幅图像，而非该前景掩码。

paragraphs.en: Table 3 (b) compares released FaceLift, the checkpoint after 3,240 random-camera/background-adaptation updates, and its continuation for 3,240 updates with view-aware corruption, all from the 16-camera training lineage. All three receive the same five Stage-I-generated inputs at every time index: the four 416 × 608 416\times 608 grid cells for cameras 222200042 , 221501007 , 222200044 , and 222200045 , and the generated frontal view for 222200037 , fitted to the same canvas with aspect-preserving Lanczos resizing and white padding. No synthetic corruption is added at evaluation time. Each checkpoint reconstructs one Gaussian cloud per frame, then renders that cloud at all 16 calibrated cameras: 220700191 , 221501007 , and 222200036 – 222200049 . These are training-pool cameras, not the four held-out cameras of the 12-camera variant in Appendix D.1 . We evaluate frames 1–80, excluding the anchor, for 8 × 80 × 16 = 10,240 8\times 80\times 16=10{,}240 image pairs per row. All rows use the same renderer and model configuration, without post-hoc Gaussian filtering. Predictions are rendered on white, clamped to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , and rounded to uint8 RGB. They are compared directly with the existing matted, white-background GT at 416 × 608 416\times 608 , with no additional crop, registration, or GT mask applied to predictions. All three metrics use the full image, including any floating artifacts outside the GT silhouette.
paragraphs.zh: 表3 (b) 比较了已发布的 FaceLift、经过 3,240 次随机相机/背景适配更新后的检查点，以及在此基础上继续进行 3,240 次带视角感知腐蚀的更新的结果，三者均来自 16 相机训练谱系。 所有三个检查点在每个时间索引都接收相同的五个 Stage-I 生成的输入：相机 222200042、221501007、222200044 和 222200045 的四个 416 × 608 416\times 608 网格单元，以及为 222200037 生成的正面视图，均通过保持纵横比的 Lanczos 缩放和白色填充适配到相同画布上。 评估时不添加任何合成腐蚀。 每个检查点对每帧重建一个高斯点云，然后在全部 16 个标定相机上渲染该点云：220700191、221501007 以及 222200036–222200049。 这些是训练池中的相机，而非附录 D.1 中 12 相机变体的四个留出相机。 我们评估第 1–80 帧（不含锚点帧），即每行 8 × 80 × 16 = 10,240 8\times 80\times 16=10{,}240 个图像对。 所有行使用相同的渲染器和模型配置，不进行事后高斯点过滤。 预测结果在白色背景上渲染，裁剪到 [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] 区间，并舍入为 uint8 RGB。 它们直接与现有的 416 × 608 416\times 608 抠像白底 GT 进行比较，不对预测结果施加任何额外的裁剪、配准或 GT 掩码。 所有三个指标均使用完整图像，包括 GT 轮廓之外的任何漂浮伪影。

sents.en: Table 3 (b) compares released FaceLift, the checkpoint after 3,240 random-camera/background-adaptation updates, and its continuation for 3,240 updates with view-aware corruption, all from the 16-camera training lineage.
sents.zh: 表3 (b) 比较了已发布的 FaceLift、经过 3,240 次随机相机/背景适配更新后的检查点，以及在此基础上继续进行 3,240 次带视角感知腐蚀的更新的结果，三者均来自 16 相机训练谱系。
