paragraphs.en: We compute per-image PSNR from float64 RGB squared errors, SSIM with channel_axis=2 , data_range=255 , and the default uniform 7 × 7 7\times 7 window, and AlexNet LPIPS v0.1 on RGB values mapped to [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] . For each identity, we average its 81 frame scores in part (a), or its 80 × 16 80\times 16 frame–camera scores in part (b), then average the eight identity means with equal weight. PSNR is averaged in dB after each image’s MSE is converted to PSNR, not computed from one pooled MSE. Aggregation uses unrounded values; the table shows two decimal places for PSNR and four for SSIM and LPIPS.
paragraphs.zh: 我们基于 float64 RGB 平方误差计算每张图像的 PSNR，SSIM 采用 channel_axis=2、data_range=255 以及默认的均匀 7 × 7 7\times 7 窗口，AlexNet LPIPS v0.1 则在映射到 [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] 的 RGB 值上计算。 对于每个身份，我们在部分 (a) 中对其 81 帧分数取平均，或在部分 (b) 中对其 80 × 16 80\times 16 帧–相机分数取平均，然后对八个身份的均值以相等权重再取平均。 PSNR 是在每张图像的 MSE 转换为 PSNR 后以 dB 取平均，而不是由一个汇总的 MSE 计算得出。 聚合使用未舍入的数值；表中 PSNR 显示两位小数，SSIM 和 LPIPS 显示四位小数。

sents.en: We compute per-image PSNR from float64 RGB squared errors, SSIM with channel_axis=2 , data_range=255 , and the default uniform 7 × 7 7\times 7 window, and AlexNet LPIPS v0.1 on RGB values mapped to [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] .
sents.zh: 我们基于 float64 RGB 平方误差计算每张图像的 PSNR，SSIM 采用 channel_axis=2、data_range=255 以及默认的均匀 7 × 7 7\times 7 窗口，AlexNet LPIPS v0.1 则在映射到 [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] 的 RGB 值上计算。

sents.en: For each identity, we average its 81 frame scores in part (a), or its 80 × 16 80\times 16 frame–camera scores in part (b), then average the eight identity means with equal weight.
sents.zh: 对于每个身份，我们在部分 (a) 中对其 81 帧分数取平均，或在部分 (b) 中对其 80 × 16 80\times 16 帧–相机分数取平均，然后对八个身份的均值以相等权重再取平均。

sents.en: PSNR is averaged in dB after each image’s MSE is converted to PSNR, not computed from one pooled MSE.
sents.zh: PSNR 是在每张图像的 MSE 转换为 PSNR 后以 dB 取平均，而不是由一个汇总的 MSE 计算得出。

sents.en: Aggregation uses unrounded values; the table shows two decimal places for PSNR and four for SSIM and LPIPS.
sents.zh: 聚合使用未舍入的数值；表中 PSNR 显示两位小数，SSIM 和 LPIPS 显示四位小数。

paragraphs.en: We additionally evaluate whether the Stage-II improvements extend beyond the training viewpoints. The 12-camera variant excludes cameras 222200046 , 222200040 , 222200049 , and 222200039 from both source-view sampling and real-target supervision throughout training. We use the same eight training-disjoint identities and fixed five Stage-I-generated input views as in Appendix B.9 . At each time index, each checkpoint reconstructs one Gaussian cloud, which is rendered at all four held-out cameras and compared with their simultaneous GT observations. The full-camera model used for the external comparisons is not used in this experiment, since these cameras are not held out for that model.
paragraphs.zh: 我们进一步评估 Stage-II 的改进是否能延伸到训练视角之外。 12 相机变体在整个训练过程中将相机 222200046、222200040、222200049 和 222200039 从源视角采样和真实目标监督中排除。 我们使用与附录 B.9 中相同的八个与训练不相交的身份以及固定的五个 Stage-I 生成的输入视图。 在每个时间索引处，每个检查点重建一个高斯点云，并在全部四个保留相机上进行渲染，与这些相机同时刻的真值观测进行比较。 用于外部对比的全相机模型未在本实验中使用，因为该模型并未保留这些相机。

sents.en: We additionally evaluate whether the Stage-II improvements extend beyond the training viewpoints.
sents.zh: 我们进一步评估 Stage-II 的改进是否能延伸到训练视角之外。

sents.en: The 12-camera variant excludes cameras 222200046 , 222200040 , 222200049 , and 222200039 from both source-view sampling and real-target supervision throughout training.
sents.zh: 12 相机变体在整个训练过程中将相机 222200046、222200040、222200049 和 222200039 从源视角采样和真实目标监督中排除。

sents.en: We use the same eight training-disjoint identities and fixed five Stage-I-generated input views as in Appendix B.9 .
sents.zh: 我们使用与附录 B.9 中相同的八个与训练不相交的身份以及固定的五个 Stage-I 生成的输入视图。

sents.en: At each time index, each checkpoint reconstructs one Gaussian cloud, which is rendered at all four held-out cameras and compared with their simultaneous GT observations.
sents.zh: 在每个时间索引处，每个检查点重建一个高斯点云，并在全部四个保留相机上进行渲染，与这些相机同时刻的真值观测进行比较。

sents.en: The full-camera model used for the external comparisons is not used in this experiment, since these cameras are not held out for that model.
sents.zh: 用于外部对比的全相机模型未在本实验中使用，因为该模型并未保留这些相机。

paragraphs.en: Table 7 reports the anchor frame separately from the audio-driven frames: frame 0 gives 8 × 4 = 32 8\times 4=32 image pairs per checkpoint, and frames 1–80 give 8 × 80 × 4 = 2,560 8\times 80\times 4=2{,}560 . All scores use the full 416 × 608 416\times 608 RGB image on white, the same renderer and calibrated cameras, and no post-hoc Gaussian filtering or GT masking of predictions. PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS follow the implementation above; we first average over the four cameras and the selected frames within each identity, then average the eight identity means equally. The frontal camera is not included in this table. Scores on frames 1–80 also reflect differences between the generated and recorded facial performance, so they are kept separate from the anchor-frame comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 表 7 将锚点帧与音频驱动帧分开报告：帧 0 在每个检查点上给出 8 × 4 = 32 个图像对，帧 1–80 给出 8 × 80 × 4 = 2,560 个图像对。 所有分数均使用白色背景上的完整 416 × 608 RGB 图像、相同的渲染器和标定好的相机，并且不对预测结果做任何事后高斯滤波或真实值掩膜处理。 PSNR、SSIM 和 LPIPS 遵循上述实现方式；我们先在每个身份内部对四台相机和所选帧取平均，然后对八个身份的均值进行等权平均。 正面相机未包含在本表中。 帧 1–80 上的分数还反映了生成的面部表演与录制的面部表演之间的差异，因此将其与锚点帧的对比分开保留。

sents.en: Table 7 reports the anchor frame separately from the audio-driven frames: frame 0 gives 8 × 4 = 32 8\times 4=32 image pairs per checkpoint, and frames 1–80 give 8 × 80 × 4 = 2,560 8\times 80\times 4=2{,}560 .
sents.zh: 表 7 将锚点帧与音频驱动帧分开报告：帧 0 在每个检查点上给出 8 × 4 = 32 个图像对，帧 1–80 给出 8 × 80 × 4 = 2,560 个图像对。

sents.en: All scores use the full 416 × 608 416\times 608 RGB image on white, the same renderer and calibrated cameras, and no post-hoc Gaussian filtering or GT masking of predictions.
sents.zh: 所有分数均使用白色背景上的完整 416 × 608 RGB 图像、相同的渲染器和标定好的相机，并且不对预测结果做任何事后高斯滤波或真实值掩膜处理。

sents.en: PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS follow the implementation above; we first average over the four cameras and the selected frames within each identity, then average the eight identity means equally.
sents.zh: PSNR、SSIM 和 LPIPS 遵循上述实现方式；我们先在每个身份内部对四台相机和所选帧取平均，然后对八个身份的均值进行等权平均。

sents.en: The frontal camera is not included in this table.
sents.zh: 正面相机未包含在本表中。

sents.en: Scores on frames 1–80 also reflect differences between the generated and recorded facial performance, so they are kept separate from the anchor-frame comparison.
sents.zh: 帧 1–80 上的分数还反映了生成的面部表演与录制的面部表演之间的差异，因此将其与锚点帧的对比分开保留。

paragraphs.en: The full 12-camera model improves all three mean metrics over released FaceLift in both temporal splits, supporting generalization beyond the training cameras. The corruption-trained checkpoint also improves all three metrics over the preceding fine-tuned checkpoint. The full model has the highest PSNR, while the corruption-trained intermediate checkpoint has slightly better SSIM and LPIPS.
paragraphs.zh: 完整的 12 相机模型在两个时间划分上均超越已发布的 FaceLift 的三项平均指标，支持了其在训练相机之外泛化的能力。 经过腐蚀训练的检查点在前一个微调检查点的基础上也提升了全部三项指标。 完整模型的 PSNR 最高，而腐蚀训练的中间检查点在 SSIM 和 LPIPS 上略优。

sents.en: The full 12-camera model improves all three mean metrics over released FaceLift in both temporal splits, supporting generalization beyond the training cameras.
sents.zh: 完整的 12 相机模型在两个时间划分上均超越已发布的 FaceLift 的三项平均指标，支持了其在训练相机之外泛化的能力。

sents.en: The corruption-trained checkpoint also improves all three metrics over the preceding fine-tuned checkpoint.
sents.zh: 经过腐蚀训练的检查点在前一个微调检查点的基础上也提升了全部三项指标。

sents.en: The full model has the highest PSNR, while the corruption-trained intermediate checkpoint has slightly better SSIM and LPIPS.
sents.zh: 完整模型的 PSNR 最高，而腐蚀训练的中间检查点在 SSIM 和 LPIPS 上略优。

paragraphs.en: We measure mouth opening as the central inner-lip distance divided by the mouth-corner distance, using the image coordinates of InsightFace buffalo_l 68-point landmarks on 512 × 512 512\times 512 frontal frames and selecting the largest detected face. We greedily decode phonemes from the driving audio with wav2vec2-lv-60-espeak-cv-ft , retain tokens with peak posterior at least 0.5, and sample the nearest 25-fps frame to each token-run midpoint, shifted 40 ms earlier for /b/ and /p/ . The contrast is the mean normalized opening at /a/ -type open vowels minus that at /m/ , /b/ , and /p/ , pooling valid tokens across the 16 clips rather than averaging clip means. For each method, we search one shared integer offset across all clips within [ − 6 , 6 ] [-6,6] frames and report the maximum contrast; this is not a separate alignment for each clip. Missing detections and out-of-range frames are excluded. At the selected offsets, all methods have 82 open-vowel and 81 bilabial observations, with none missing. This is an auxiliary diagnostic of audio-conditioned opening–closing contrast.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将张口度定义为上唇内侧中心距离除以嘴角距离，使用 InsightFace buffalo_l 68 点关键点在 512 × 512 512\times 512 正面帧上的图像坐标，并选取检测到的最大人脸。 我们用 wav2vec2-lv-60-espeak-cv-ft 从驱动音频中贪心地解码音素，保留峰值后验概率不低于 0.5 的标记，并采样距离每个标记段中点最近的 25-fps 帧，对 /b/ 和 /p/ 将该中点提前 40 ms。 该对比度是 /a/ 类开口元音处的平均归一化张口度减去 /m/、/b/、/p/ 处的平均归一化张口度，将 16 个片段中的有效标记汇总计算，而不是对各片段均值取平均。 对于每种方法，我们在 [ − 6 , 6 ] [-6,6] 帧范围内跨所有片段搜索一个共享的整数偏移量，并报告最大对比度；这不是针对每个片段单独进行的对齐。 缺失检测和超出范围的帧均被排除。 在所选偏移量处，所有方法均有 82 个开口元音观测值和 81 个双唇音观测值，且无缺失。 这是对音频条件下的开闭口对比度的一项辅助性诊断指标。

sents.en: We measure mouth opening as the central inner-lip distance divided by the mouth-corner distance, using the image coordinates of InsightFace buffalo_l 68-point landmarks on 512 × 512 512\times 512 frontal frames and selecting the largest detected face.
sents.zh: 我们将张口度定义为上唇内侧中心距离除以嘴角距离，使用 InsightFace buffalo_l 68 点关键点在 512 × 512 512\times 512 正面帧上的图像坐标，并选取检测到的最大人脸。

sents.en: We greedily decode phonemes from the driving audio with wav2vec2-lv-60-espeak-cv-ft , retain tokens with peak posterior at least 0.5, and sample the nearest 25-fps frame to each token-run midpoint, shifted 40 ms earlier for /b/ and /p/ .
sents.zh: 我们用 wav2vec2-lv-60-espeak-cv-ft 从驱动音频中贪心地解码音素，保留峰值后验概率不低于 0.5 的标记，并采样距离每个标记段中点最近的 25-fps 帧，对 /b/ 和 /p/ 将该中点提前 40 ms。

sents.en: The contrast is the mean normalized opening at /a/ -type open vowels minus that at /m/ , /b/ , and /p/ , pooling valid tokens across the 16 clips rather than averaging clip means.

sents.en: For each method, we search one shared integer offset across all clips within [ − 6 , 6 ] [-6,6] frames and report the maximum contrast; this is not a separate alignment for each clip.
sents.zh: 对于每种方法，我们在 [ − 6 , 6 ] [-6,6] 帧范围内跨所有片段搜索一个共享的整数偏移量，并报告最大对比度；这不是针对每个片段单独进行的对齐。

sents.zh: 缺失检测和超出范围的帧均被排除。

sents.en: At the selected offsets, all methods have 82 open-vowel and 81 bilabial observations, with none missing.
sents.zh: 在所选偏移量处，所有方法均有 82 个开口元音观测值和 81 个双唇音观测值，且无缺失。

paragraphs.en: We reshape each stream’s tokens into temporal groups, concatenate the canvas and frontal blocks along the within-group token dimension, and then flatten time and token dimensions into one sequence. The order is [ P c 0 ∥ P f 0 ∥ P c 1 ∥ P f 1 ∥ ⋯ ] [P_{c}^{0}\|P_{f}^{0}\|P_{c}^{1}\|P_{f}^{1}\|\cdots] . Thus each consecutive block of 4940 tokens belongs to one latent time. This is block-wise ordering by time, not alternation of individual canvas and frontal tokens. Appending the entire frontal sequence after the entire canvas sequence would not preserve the inherited equal-size, per-time audio partitions without changing that routing logic.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将每个模态流的词元重组为时间组，沿组内词元维度拼接画布块与面部块，然后将时间维度和词元维度展平成一个序列。 其顺序为 [ P c 0 ∥ P f 0 ∥ P c 1 ∥ P f 1 ∥ ⋯ ] [P_{c}^{0}\|P_{f}^{0}\|P_{c}^{1}\|P_{f}^{1}\|\cdots] 。 因此，每连续的 4940 个词元构成一个潜在时间步。 这是按时间的块级排序，而不是单个画布词元与面部词元的交替排列。 若将整个面部序列追加在整个画布序列之后，在不改变该路由逻辑的情况下，将无法保持继承而来的等大小、按时间划分的音频分区。

paragraphs.en: The canvas token map has height 76 and width 52; the frontal token map has height 38 and width 26. At each model time t t , canvas tokens retain positions ( t , h , w ) (t,h,w) with 0 ≤ h < 76 0\leq h<76 and 0 ≤ w < 52 0\leq w<52 . Frontal tokens use ( t , h , w + 52 ) (t,h,w+52) with 0 ≤ h < 38 0\leq h<38 and 0 ≤ w < 26 0\leq w<26 . Consequently, tokens from the same time share a temporal coordinate while occupying distinct spatial positions. We construct these coordinates in exactly the same order as the token sequence and apply the backbone’s temporal, height, and width RoPE frequency bands. No additional view embedding is active in the final model. These are positional coordinates for attention, not camera extrinsics or an explicit 3D encoding. Global self-attention can exchange information across views and times.

paragraphs.en: The shared head maps each token to 64 values, corresponding to a 1 × 2 × 2 1\times 2\times 2 patch with 16 latent channels. We reshape its output into 22 groups of 4940 tokens, split each group into the first 3952 canvas tokens and the remaining 988 frontal tokens, and unpatchify each onto its own latent grid. After discarding the context predictions, the outputs supervise or update the respective 21-frame latent sequences. The two streams use matching denoising schedules. The frozen VAE decodes the completed canvas and frontal latents separately; splitting the decoded canvas into its four cells gives the four oblique videos alongside the fifth frontal video.

paragraphs.en: A frozen Wav2Vec2-Base encoder extracts 768-dimensional speech features at a 16 kHz audio sampling rate. The inherited audio adapter first applies a bias-free linear projection to width 1536 followed by layer normalization. It then constructs one local feature window per video latent time using the original RGB-frame timeline and the VAE’s temporal compression. Each window is expanded by four audio-token positions on either side. Indices beyond the feature sequence are padded with zeros to form a rectangular batch. For an unpadded 3.24-second waveform corresponding to 81 frames at 25 fps, the encoder receives 51,840 samples and returns 161 features. The inherited windowing rule yields 21 windows of 15 positions each, giving a tensor of shape B × 21 × 15 × 1536 B\times 21\times 15\times 1536 . Boundary padding is appended on the right after slicing the valid features and remains unmasked in attention.
paragraphs.zh: 一个冻结的 Wav2Vec2-Base 编码器在 16 kHz 音频采样率下提取 768 维语音特征。 继承的音频适配器首先应用一个无偏置的线性投影到宽度 1536，随后进行层归一化。 然后它使用原始 RGB 帧时间线和 VAE 的时间压缩，为每个视频潜变量时间点构建一个局部特征窗口。 每个窗口在两侧各扩展四个音频词元位置。 超出特征序列的索引用零填充，以形成矩形的批次。 对于一个对应 25 fps 下 81 帧的无填充 3.24 秒波形，编码器接收 51,840 个采样点并返回 161 个特征。 继承的窗口划分规则产生 21 个各含 15 个位置的窗口，得到形状为 B × 21 × 15 × 1536 B\times 21\times 15\times 1536 的张量。 在切分出有效特征后，边界填充被附加在右侧，并在注意力中保持不被掩蔽。

sents.en: A frozen Wav2Vec2-Base encoder extracts 768-dimensional speech features at a 16 kHz audio sampling rate.
sents.zh: 一个冻结的 Wav2Vec2-Base 编码器在 16 kHz 音频采样率下提取 768 维语音特征。

sents.en: The inherited audio adapter first applies a bias-free linear projection to width 1536 followed by layer normalization.
sents.zh: 继承的音频适配器首先应用一个无偏置的线性投影到宽度 1536，随后进行层归一化。

sents.en: It then constructs one local feature window per video latent time using the original RGB-frame timeline and the VAE’s temporal compression.
sents.zh: 然后它使用原始 RGB 帧时间线和 VAE 的时间压缩，为每个视频潜变量时间点构建一个局部特征窗口。

sents.en: Each window is expanded by four audio-token positions on either side.
sents.zh: 每个窗口在两侧各扩展四个音频词元位置。

sents.en: Indices beyond the feature sequence are padded with zeros to form a rectangular batch.
sents.zh: 超出特征序列的索引用零填充，以形成矩形的批次。

sents.en: For an unpadded 3.24-second waveform corresponding to 81 frames at 25 fps, the encoder receives 51,840 samples and returns 161 features.
sents.zh: 对于一个对应 25 fps 下 81 帧的无填充 3.24 秒波形，编码器接收 51,840 个采样点并返回 161 个特征。

sents.en: The inherited windowing rule yields 21 windows of 15 positions each, giving a tensor of shape B × 21 × 15 × 1536 B\times 21\times 15\times 1536 .
sents.zh: 继承的窗口划分规则产生 21 个各含 15 个位置的窗口，得到形状为 B × 21 × 15 × 1536 B\times 21\times 15\times 1536 的张量。

sents.en: Boundary padding is appended on the right after slicing the valid features and remains unmasked in attention.
sents.zh: 在切分出有效特征后，边界填充被附加在右侧，并在注意力中保持不被掩蔽。

paragraphs.en: Two frozen audio-adapter blocks refine the projected windows. Here audio tokens are queries, while the corresponding noisy canvas patch tokens are keys and values. The visual context comes from patch embedding before the first diffusion-transformer block. We remove the clean reference group and select only the canvas portion of every target-time group, giving B × 21 × 3952 × 1536 B\times 21\times 3952\times 1536 visual context. Each adapter block uses eight attention heads of width 192 and a feed-forward layer of width 3072. The diffusion-timestep embedding modulates its normalized features and residual branches, and a final modulated head produces the refined audio context.
paragraphs.zh: 两个冻结的音频适配器模块对投影后的窗口进行精细化处理。 在这里，音频标记作为查询，而对应的含噪画布块标记作为键和值。 视觉上下文来自第一个扩散-transformer 模块之前的块嵌入。 我们移除干净参考组，仅选取每个目标时间组的画布部分，得到 B × 21 × 3952 × 1536 B\times 21\times 3952\times 1536 的视觉上下文。 每个适配器模块使用八个宽度为 192 的注意力头和一个宽度为 3072 的前馈层。 扩散时间步嵌入对其归一化特征和残差分支进行调制，最终由一个经过调制的输出头生成精细化后的音频上下文。

sents.en: Two frozen audio-adapter blocks refine the projected windows.
sents.zh: 两个冻结的音频适配器模块对投影后的窗口进行精细化处理。

sents.en: Here audio tokens are queries, while the corresponding noisy canvas patch tokens are keys and values.
sents.zh: 在这里，音频标记作为查询，而对应的含噪画布块标记作为键和值。

sents.en: The visual context comes from patch embedding before the first diffusion-transformer block.
sents.zh: 视觉上下文来自第一个扩散-transformer 模块之前的块嵌入。

sents.en: We remove the clean reference group and select only the canvas portion of every target-time group, giving B × 21 × 3952 × 1536 B\times 21\times 3952\times 1536 visual context.
sents.zh: 我们移除干净参考组，仅选取每个目标时间组的画布部分，得到 B × 21 × 3952 × 1536 B\times 21\times 3952\times 1536 的视觉上下文。

sents.en: Each adapter block uses eight attention heads of width 192 and a feed-forward layer of width 3072.
sents.zh: 每个适配器模块使用八个宽度为 192 的注意力头和一个宽度为 3072 的前馈层。

sents.en: The diffusion-timestep embedding modulates its normalized features and residual branches, and a final modulated head produces the refined audio context.
sents.zh: 扩散时间步嵌入对其归一化特征和残差分支进行调制，最终由一个经过调制的输出头生成精细化后的音频上下文。

paragraphs.en: We prepend an all-zero audio context for t = 0 t=0 , producing B × 22 × 15 × 1536 B\times 22\times 15\times 1536 contexts in the standard example. Within each of the 30 diffusion-transformer blocks, the visual tokens are queries and the refined audio features are keys and values. Both canvas and frontal tokens at time t t query that time’s audio context. Reshaping time into the batch dimension implements this routing, using 12 heads of width 128. Each block’s audio cross-attention weights are shared across all time groups. The audio adapter runs once per diffusion-transformer forward pass; its output is reused across all 30 blocks and recomputed at the next denoising step.
paragraphs.zh: 我们为 t = 0 t=0 前置一个全零音频上下文，在标准示例中得到 B × 22 × 15 × 1536 B\times 22\times 15\times 1536 的上下文。 在 30 个扩散 Transformer 块的每一个中，视觉 token 作为查询，精炼后的音频特征作为键和值。 时间 t t 处的画布 token 与正面 token 都查询该时间的音频上下文。 通过将时间维度并入批量维度来实现这种路由，使用 12 个宽度为 128 的头。 每个块的音频交叉注意力权重在所有时间组之间共享。 音频适配器在每次扩散 Transformer 前向传播中运行一次；其输出在所有 30 个块中复用，并在下一个去噪步骤中重新计算。

sents.en: We prepend an all-zero audio context for t = 0 t=0 , producing B × 22 × 15 × 1536 B\times 22\times 15\times 1536 contexts in the standard example.
sents.zh: 我们为 t = 0 t=0 前置一个全零音频上下文，在标准示例中得到 B × 22 × 15 × 1536 B\times 22\times 15\times 1536 的上下文。

sents.en: Within each of the 30 diffusion-transformer blocks, the visual tokens are queries and the refined audio features are keys and values.
sents.zh: 在 30 个扩散 Transformer 块的每一个中，视觉 token 作为查询，精炼后的音频特征作为键和值。

sents.en: Both canvas and frontal tokens at time t t query that time’s audio context.
sents.zh: 时间 t t 处的画布 token 与正面 token 都查询该时间的音频上下文。

sents.en: Reshaping time into the batch dimension implements this routing, using 12 heads of width 128.
sents.zh: 通过将时间维度并入批量维度来实现这种路由，使用 12 个宽度为 128 的头。

sents.en: Each block’s audio cross-attention weights are shared across all time groups.
sents.zh: 每个块的音频交叉注意力权重在所有时间组之间共享。

sents.en: The audio adapter runs once per diffusion-transformer forward pass; its output is reused across all 30 blocks and recomputed at the next denoising step.
sents.zh: 音频适配器在每次扩散 Transformer 前向传播中运行一次；其输出在所有 30 个块中复用，并在下一个去噪步骤中重新计算。

paragraphs.en: The frozen image encoder supplies portrait features to the inherited image cross-attention pathway, separately from the VAE reference context in Appendix C.1 . The frozen text encoder provides the prompt context. Within a diffusion-transformer block, the text, image, and audio attention outputs are summed before the shared cross-attention output projection. We inherit these conditioning modules from StableAvatar.
paragraphs.zh: 冻结的图像编码器将人像特征提供给继承的图像交叉注意力通路，与附录 C.1 中的 VAE 参考上下文相互独立。 冻结的文本编码器提供提示词上下文。 在扩散 Transformer 块中，文本、图像和音频的注意力输出在共享的交叉注意力输出投影之前先进行求和。 我们从 StableAvatar 继承这些条件控制模块。

sents.en: The frozen image encoder supplies portrait features to the inherited image cross-attention pathway, separately from the VAE reference context in Appendix C.1 .
sents.zh: 冻结的图像编码器将人像特征提供给继承的图像交叉注意力通路，与附录 C.1 中的 VAE 参考上下文相互独立。

sents.en: The frozen text encoder provides the prompt context.
sents.zh: 冻结的文本编码器提供提示词上下文。

sents.en: Within a diffusion-transformer block, the text, image, and audio attention outputs are summed before the shared cross-attention output projection.
sents.zh: 在扩散 Transformer 块中，文本、图像和音频的注意力输出在共享的交叉注意力输出投影之前先进行求和。

sents.en: We inherit these conditioning modules from StableAvatar.
sents.zh: 我们从 StableAvatar 继承这些条件控制模块。

paragraphs.en: We obtain the four-view frame-conditioned warm start by fine-tuning only transformer self-attention from the released StableAvatar weights (Table 9 ). The five-view model is initialized from this warm start and additionally trains patch embedding and the output head, giving approximately 283.7 million trainable parameters. The VAE, text/image/audio encoders, audio adapter, text/image/audio cross-attention, and transformer feed-forward layers remain frozen in both models.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过仅在已发布的 StableAvatar 权重基础上微调 transformer 自注意力，得到四视角帧条件热启动模型（表 9）。 五视角模型由该热启动模型初始化，并额外训练 patch embedding 和输出头，可训练参数约为 2.837 亿。 在这两个模型中，VAE、文本/图像/音频编码器、音频适配器、文本/图像/音频交叉注意力以及 transformer 前馈层均保持冻结。

sents.en: We obtain the four-view frame-conditioned warm start by fine-tuning only transformer self-attention from the released StableAvatar weights (Table 9 ).
sents.zh: 我们通过仅在已发布的 StableAvatar 权重基础上微调 transformer 自注意力，得到四视角帧条件热启动模型（表 9）。

sents.en: The five-view model is initialized from this warm start and additionally trains patch embedding and the output head, giving approximately 283.7 million trainable parameters.
sents.zh: 五视角模型由该热启动模型初始化，并额外训练 patch embedding 和输出头，可训练参数约为 2.837 亿。

sents.en: The VAE, text/image/audio encoders, audio adapter, text/image/audio cross-attention, and transformer feed-forward layers remain frozen in both models.

paragraphs.en: For each training sample, one random draw selects a spatial weighting mode shared by both streams. The default probabilities are 0.4 for full-frame, 0.1 for face-focused, and 0.5 for lip-focused supervision. Full-frame weighting uses 1 + m face + m lip 1+m_{\mathrm{face}}+m_{\mathrm{lip}} , while the other two modes use their corresponding masks. Each stream uses its own masks resized to its latent resolution with trilinear interpolation. If a lip mask is absent or empty, its face mask is used instead. The weighted squared error is averaged over the complete latent tensor, rather than normalized by only the masked region; the inherited flow-time weighting is also applied. The two stream losses are summed with frontal coefficient 1.0.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个训练样本，通过一次随机抽取选定一个空间加权模式，该模式由两个流共享。 默认概率为：全帧 0.4、面部聚焦 0.1、唇部聚焦 0.5。 全帧加权使用 1 + m face + m lip 1+m_{\mathrm{face}}+m_{\mathrm{lip}}，另外两种模式则使用各自对应的掩码。 每个流使用自己的掩码，并通过三线性插值将其缩放到该流各自的潜空间分辨率。 如果唇部掩码缺失或为空，则改用其面部掩码。 加权平方误差是在完整的潜张量上取平均，而不是仅按掩码区域进行归一化；同时还会应用继承自流生成阶段的加权。 两个流的损失以正面系数 1.0 相加。

paragraphs.en: The qualitative Stage-II component ablations use a 12-camera NeRSemble training pool. The four remaining cameras, 222200046 , 222200040 , 222200049 , and 222200039 , are excluded from both source-view sampling and real-target supervision throughout training. This preserves a camera-holdout protocol for assessing generalization beyond the training viewpoints, separately from the identity-disjoint data split.
paragraphs.zh: 定性的第二阶段组件消融实验使用包含12台相机的NeRSemble训练池。 其余四台相机（222200046、222200040、222200049和222200039）在整个训练过程中均被排除在源视图采样和真实目标监督之外。 这保留了一种相机留出协议，用于评估超出训练视点的泛化能力，该协议与身份不相交的数据划分是分开的。

sents.zh: 定性的第二阶段组件消融实验使用包含12台相机的NeRSemble训练池。

paragraphs.en: For the main comparisons on RenderMe-360 and HDTF, we retrain from the released FaceLift checkpoint using the same curriculum and the same 648-clip NeRSemble training subset, but expand the eligible source and supervision pool to all 16 cameras. The four cameras listed above are therefore no longer held out for this variant. No RenderMe-360 or HDTF evaluation data are used for this adaptation. The quantitative checkpoint comparison in Table 3 (b) also uses this 16-camera training lineage. Its cameras are not held out from training.
paragraphs.zh: 针对 RenderMe-360 和 HDTF 上的主要对比实验，我们从已发布的 FaceLift 检查点出发，使用相同的课程训练策略和相同的 648 段 NeRSemble 训练子集进行重训练，但将可用的源视角和监督池扩展到全部 16 个相机。 因此，在这一变体中，上述列出的四个相机不再被留出。 该适配过程未使用任何 RenderMe-360 或 HDTF 的评估数据。 表 3 (b) 中的定量检查点对比同样使用这一 16 相机训练谱系。 其相机并未在训练中被留出。

paragraphs.en: Both variants reconstruct from five source views; 12 and 16 denote the training camera-pool sizes, not the number of simultaneous reconstruction inputs. At inference, both receive the four grid views and the frontal view generated by Stage I. The full-camera variant is not used to establish generalization to the four held-out NeRSemble cameras.
paragraphs.zh: 两种变体均从五个源视角进行重建；12 和 16 表示训练时的相机池大小，而非同时重建输入的数量。 在推理阶段，两者均接收四个网格视角以及由第一阶段生成的正面视角。 全相机变体不用于建立对四个保留的 NeRSemble 相机的泛化能力。

sents.en: Both variants reconstruct from five source views; 12 and 16 denote the training camera-pool sizes, not the number of simultaneous reconstruction inputs.
sents.zh: 两种变体均从五个源视角进行重建；12 和 16 表示训练时的相机池大小，而非同时重建输入的数量。

sents.zh: 全相机变体不用于建立对四个保留的 NeRSemble 相机的泛化能力。

paragraphs.en: For each sampled set of five source cameras, we keep the most-frontal view clean and apply corruption to the other four. We identify this anchor by the smallest angle between a camera’s optical axis and that of the frontal camera 222200037 , using a fixed ranking derived from the calibrated NeRSemble rig. The choice is made within the sampled set, preserving the source-view order. Grid distortion and camera jitter are each enabled with probability 0.5 0.5 , using independent scene-level draws. When enabled, an operation applies to all four non-anchor views, with independently sampled warp fields or pose offsets. Both operations can occur in the same sample. Only source inputs are corrupted; all reconstruction targets and target cameras remain unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每组采样的五个源相机，我们保持最正面的视图不受到破坏，并对其余四个视图施加破坏。 我们通过相机的光轴与正面相机 222200037 的光轴之间的最小夹角来确定这个锚点，采用由标定的 NeRSemble 相机架导出的固定排序。 该选择在采样集合内进行，并保持源视图的顺序。 网格畸变和相机抖动各自以 0.5 0.5 的概率启用，使用独立的场景级抽取。 启用时，一个操作会作用于全部四个非锚点视图，并使用独立采样的形变场或位姿偏移。 两个操作可以在同一样本中同时发生。 只有源输入被破坏；所有重建目标和目标相机保持不变。

sents.en: For each sampled set of five source cameras, we keep the most-frontal view clean and apply corruption to the other four.
sents.zh: 对于每组采样的五个源相机，我们保持最正面的视图不受到破坏，并对其余四个视图施加破坏。

sents.en: We identify this anchor by the smallest angle between a camera’s optical axis and that of the frontal camera 222200037 , using a fixed ranking derived from the calibrated NeRSemble rig.
sents.zh: 我们通过相机的光轴与正面相机 222200037 的光轴之间的最小夹角来确定这个锚点，采用由标定的 NeRSemble 相机架导出的固定排序。

sents.en: The choice is made within the sampled set, preserving the source-view order.
sents.zh: 该选择在采样集合内进行，并保持源视图的顺序。

sents.en: Grid distortion and camera jitter are each enabled with probability 0.5 0.5 , using independent scene-level draws.
sents.zh: 网格畸变和相机抖动各自以 0.5 0.5 的概率启用，使用独立的场景级抽取。

sents.en: When enabled, an operation applies to all four non-anchor views, with independently sampled warp fields or pose offsets.
sents.zh: 启用时，一个操作会作用于全部四个非锚点视图，并使用独立采样的形变场或位姿偏移。

sents.en: Both operations can occur in the same sample.
sents.zh: 两个操作可以在同一样本中同时发生。

sents.en: Only source inputs are corrupted; all reconstruction targets and target cameras remain unchanged.
sents.zh: 只有源输入被破坏；所有重建目标和目标相机保持不变。

paragraphs.en: Grid distortion follows LGM ( Tang et al., 2024 ) . We uniformly sample an integer n ∈ { 8 , … , 16 } n\in\{8,\ldots,16\} once per scene and place n n control points along each image axis. For each corrupted view and axis, the normalized control-point positions are independently perturbed by uniform offsets in [ − 0.25 / ( n − 1 ) , 0.25 / ( n − 1 ) ] [-0.25/(n-1),\,0.25/(n-1)] , corresponding to distortion strength 0.5 0.5 . Positions are clamped to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , converted to pixel coordinates, and the two endpoints are fixed at the image boundaries. Piecewise-linear interpolation between control points constructs the sampling grid; bilinear sampling with align_corners=False warps the image. Camera parameters are unchanged by this operation.
paragraphs.zh: 网格畸变遵循 LGM（Tang 等，2024）。 我们在每个场景中统一采样一次整数 n ∈ {8, …, 16}，并沿每条图像轴放置 n 个控制点。 对于每张受损视图和每条轴，归一化后的控制点位置被 [−0.25/(n−1), 0.25/(n−1)] 范围内的均匀偏移独立扰动，对应畸变强度 0.5。 位置被钳制到 [0, 1]，转换为像素坐标，且两个端点固定在图像边界处。 控制点之间的分段线性插值构建采样网格；采用 align_corners=False 的双线性采样对图像进行变形。 相机参数不因该操作而改变。

sents.en: Grid distortion follows LGM ( Tang et al., 2024 ) .
sents.zh: 网格畸变遵循 LGM（Tang 等，2024）。

sents.en: We uniformly sample an integer n ∈ { 8 , … , 16 } n\in\{8,\ldots,16\} once per scene and place n n control points along each image axis.
sents.zh: 我们在每个场景中统一采样一次整数 n ∈ {8, …, 16}，并沿每条图像轴放置 n 个控制点。

sents.en: For each corrupted view and axis, the normalized control-point positions are independently perturbed by uniform offsets in [ − 0.25 / ( n − 1 ) , 0.25 / ( n − 1 ) ] [-0.25/(n-1),\,0.25/(n-1)] , corresponding to distortion strength 0.5 0.5 .
sents.zh: 对于每张受损视图和每条轴，归一化后的控制点位置被 [−0.25/(n−1), 0.25/(n−1)] 范围内的均匀偏移独立扰动，对应畸变强度 0.5。

sents.en: Positions are clamped to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , converted to pixel coordinates, and the two endpoints are fixed at the image boundaries.
sents.zh: 位置被钳制到 [0, 1]，转换为像素坐标，且两个端点固定在图像边界处。

sents.en: Piecewise-linear interpolation between control points constructs the sampling grid; bilinear sampling with align_corners=False warps the image.
sents.zh: 控制点之间的分段线性插值构建采样网格；采用 align_corners=False 的双线性采样对图像进行变形。

sents.en: Camera parameters are unchanged by this operation.
sents.zh: 相机参数不因该操作而改变。

paragraphs.en: Camera jitter samples independent uniform rotation angles in [ − 3 ∘ , 3 ∘ ] [-3^{\circ},3^{\circ}] about camera-up and [ − 1.5 ∘ , 1.5 ∘ ] [-1.5^{\circ},1.5^{\circ}] about camera-right for each corrupted view. In the OpenCV camera-to-world convention, these axes are the negative second column and the first column of the rotation matrix, respectively. We compose the camera-right rotation followed by the camera-up rotation and apply the resulting rotation to both the camera orientation and camera center about the scene origin. This preserves the camera’s distance to the origin while changing its nominal pose; its intrinsics and source image are unchanged by jitter. The same corruption settings are used for the 12-camera and 16-camera variants.
paragraphs.zh: 相机抖动针对每个受损视角，在绕相机上方轴 [ − 3 ∘ , 3 ∘ ] [-3^{\circ},3^{\circ}] 与绕相机右方轴 [ − 1.5 ∘ , 1.5 ∘ ] [-1.5^{\circ},1.5^{\circ}] 的范围内独立采样均匀分布的旋转角度。 在 OpenCV 相机到世界的约定中，这些轴分别是旋转矩阵的负第二列和第一列。 我们先进行绕相机右方轴的旋转，再进行绕相机上方轴的旋转，并将所得旋转应用于相机朝向和相机中心，均围绕场景原点进行。 这在改变相机名义位姿的同时保持了相机到原点的距离；其内参和源图像不因抖动而改变。 相同的受损设置被用于 12 相机和 16 相机两种变体。

paragraphs.en: We initialize a four-view, clean-reference-conditioned model from the released 1.3B StableAvatar weights and train transformer self-attention for 9,599 updates, approximately 24 passes over the training data. These trained four-view weights initialize the five-view model, which undergoes 6,800 additional updates. Table 9 gives the complete schedule, including the four-view warm start. The selected cooldown checkpoint is halfway through a 2,000-update linear decay, at a learning rate of approximately 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5} . Training uses 81-frame clips, a global batch size of eight for the five-view runs, seed 42, and AdamW with ( β 1 , β 2 ) = ( 0.9 , 0.999 ) (\beta_{1},\beta_{2})=(0.9,0.999) , weight decay 0.03 0.03 , ϵ = 10 − 10 \epsilon=10^{-10} , and gradient clipping at 0.05 0.05 . Gradient accumulation is one, with bfloat16 and gradient checkpointing. The trainable modules and exact loss are specified in Appendix C.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们从已发布的 1.3B StableAvatar 权重初始化一个四视角、以干净参考为条件的模型，并对 transformer 自注意力进行 9,599 次更新训练，大约相当于对训练数据的 24 遍遍历。 这些训练好的四视角权重用于初始化五视角模型，该模型随后再进行 6,800 次额外更新。 表 9 给出了完整的训练计划，包括四视角的预热启动。 所选的冷却检查点位于 2,000 次更新的线性衰减的中点，学习率约为 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5} 。 训练使用 81 帧片段，五视角运行的全局批大小为 8，随机种子为 42，优化器为 AdamW，其中 ( β 1 , β 2 ) = ( 0.9 , 0.999 ) (\beta_{1},\beta_{2})=(0.9,0.999) ，权重衰减为 0.03 0.03 ， ϵ = 10 − 10 \epsilon=10^{-10} ，梯度裁剪为 0.05 0.05 。 梯度累积为 1，并使用 bfloat16 和梯度检查点。 可训练模块和具体损失在附录 C.4 中给出。

paragraphs.en: The two camera-pool variants in Appendix D.1 follow the same schedule in Table 10 , starting from released FaceLift. The 648 training clips supply 16 frames each, at indices 0 , 5 , 11 , 16 , 21 , 27 , 32 , 37 , 43 , 48 , 53 , 59 , 64 , 69 , 75 , 80 0,5,11,16,21,27,32,37,43,48,53,59,64,69,75,80 , giving 10,368 scenes. paragraphs.en: Stage I uses 30 flow-matching Euler steps, scheduler shift 5 with dynamic shifting disabled, seed 42, and bfloat16 inference. Audio and text guidance scales are 5 and 3, respectively, with the prompt “The protagonist is talking” and StableAvatar’s default negative prompt. The four-view canvas is 832 × 1216 832\times 1216 and the frontal stream is 416 × 608 416\times 608 (width × \times height); splitting the canvas therefore gives five native-resolution 416 × 608 416\times 608 views at 25 fps. Longer sequences use 81-frame windows, corresponding to 21 latent frames, with a nominal overlap of five latent frames and a stride of 16. At every denoising step, both streams process the same windows and linearly crossfade overlapping latent updates; the first denoising step skips crossfading. The final window is shifted back to remain full-length when necessary, increasing its overlap. Stage II then reconstructs each time index independently from the five calibrated views using float16 autocast. All requested views at a given time render the same full set of predicted Gaussians. The geometry-refinement configuration retains its log-scale cap of − 1.20 -1.20 ; external-evaluation renders are 832 × 1216 832\times 1216 before the common-canvas preprocessing in Appendix B.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 阶段 I 使用 30 个流匹配 Euler 步、调度器 shift 为 5 且禁用动态移位、随机种子 42，并采用 bfloat16 推理。 音频和文本引导比例分别为 5 和 3，提示词为 "The protagonist is talking"，负向提示词使用 StableAvatar 的默认设置。 四视图画布为 832 × 1216 832\times 1216，正面流为 416 × 608 416\times 608（宽 × 高）；因此拆分画布可得到五个原生分辨率 416 × 608 416\times 608 的视图，帧率为 25 fps。 更长的序列使用 81 帧的窗口，对应 21 个潜变量帧，标称重叠为五个潜变量帧，步长为 16。 在每个去噪步骤中，两条流处理相同的窗口，并对重叠的潜变量更新进行线性交叉淡化；第一步去噪跳过交叉淡化。 必要时，最后一个窗口会向后移动以保持全长，这会增加其重叠量。 阶段 II 随后使用 float16 autocast 从五个标定后的视图中独立重建每个时间索引。 给定时间点的所有请求视图都渲染同一组完整的预测高斯。 几何细化配置保留其对数比例上限 −1.20 -1.20；外部评估渲染在附录 B.2 的通用画布预处理之前为 832 × 1216 832\times 1216。

paragraphs.en: We use the speech (SEN) recordings of NeRSemble. Data preparation retains participants with at least two SEN recordings and requires the designated source-camera videos, background reference images, and audio. Incomplete camera data and clips with missing audio are excluded; recordings must be long enough to supply 81 frames at 25 fps. For each retained recording, we take the first 81-frame window, sampling raw frame round ⁡ ( 73 ​ t / 25 ) \operatorname{round}(73t/25) for output index t = 0 , … , 80 t=0,\ldots,80 , together with the corresponding 3.24-second, 16-kHz mono audio segment. The final split contains 2,641 training clips from 328 identities and 81 development clips from ten different identities: 067, 145, 177, 222, 279, 302, 369, 413, 476, and 490. All clips of an identity belong to the same split. These ten identities are used for development and checkpoint selection. The eight-person quantitative ablation cohort in Appendix B.9 is a subset of this development split. RenderMe-360 and HDTF are external evaluations; neither is used to train or fine-tune our two stages.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 NeRSemble 的语音（SEN）录制数据。 数据准备保留拥有至少两段 SEN 录制的参与者，并要求提供指定的源摄像机视频、背景参考图像和音频。 不完整的摄像机数据以及缺少音频的片段将被排除；录制内容必须足够长，以便在 25 fps 下提供 81 帧。 对于每段保留的录制，我们取第一个 81 帧的窗口，对输出索引 t = 0, …, 80 采样原始帧 round(73t/25)，并附带对应的 3.24 秒、16 kHz 单声道音频段。 最终的划分包含来自 328 个身份的 2,641 个训练片段，以及来自十个不同身份（067、145、177、222、279、302、369、413、476 和 490）的 81 个开发片段。 同一身份的所有片段都属于同一个划分。 这十个身份用于开发和检查点选择。 附录 B.9 中的八人定量消融队列是该开发划分的一个子集。 RenderMe-360 和 HDTF 是外部评估集；两者均未用于训练或微调我们的两个阶段。

paragraphs.en: We remove NeRSemble backgrounds with BackgroundMattingV2 using the ResNet-101 checkpoint, backbone scale 0.25 0.25 , sampling refinement, and 80,000 refinement pixels. Each source frame and its recorded empty background are processed together, and the predicted foreground and alpha are composited over white. Each view is resized with Pillow Lanczos to fit within 416 × 608 416\times 608 while preserving aspect ratio, then centered with white padding; mask padding is zero. paragraphs.en: We use the released 240210_real3dportrait_orig models: audio2secc_vae at checkpoint 400,000 and secc2plane_torso_orig at checkpoint 100,000. We retain the released source-face crop threshold 0.2 0.2 , initial-pose mapping, and head/torso/background compositing. The portrait supplies the static pose and background. The source is processed at 512 × 512 512\times 512 by the released face-cropping and 3DMM estimation path. Audio is processed by the released HuBERT/F0 path, including its motion-padding convention. The internally padded 84-frame rendering is muxed with the 3.24-second audio by the original shortest-stream export, yielding the evaluated 81-frame 512 × 512 512\times 512 video.

paragraphs.en: We use SDGTalk.pt and its stored model configuration, with seed 42 for each clip. The source square is bilinearly resized to 512 × 512 512\times 512 with antialiasing, segmented with the released jonathandinu/face-parsing SegFormer, and masked to labels 1–18 with black elsewhere. The released source tracker estimates FLAME shape, expression, jaw/eye codes, and the source camera. For source eye landmarks, we select the S3FD detection with the highest confidence, breaking exact ties by bounding-box area. The source camera and six eye measurements remain fixed throughout the sequence; only audio changes over time. We retain the checkpoint’s FLAME scale 5, native focal parameter 12, 296 × 296 296\times 296 source lifting planes, 518 × 518 518\times 518 image-encoder input, and released feature-to-RGB decoder. PCM16 audio is divided by 32,768 and normalized as ( x − mean ⁡ ( x ) ) / var ⁡ ( x ) + 10 − 7 (x-\operatorname{mean}(x))/\sqrt{\operatorname{var}(x)+10^{-7}} . The last hidden states of facebook/hubert-large-ls960-ft give 161 vectors of dimension 1,024 for the 3.24-second segment. Video frame t t uses the 16-vector window with indices 2 ​ t − 8 , … , 2 ​ t + 7 2t-8,\ldots,2t+7 , with out-of-range indices filled by zero vectors. This produces an 81 × 16 × 1024 81\times 16\times 1024 audio tensor. The model outputs 512 × 512 512\times 512 RGB. Prediction-only white-background conversion is applied during evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 SDGTalk.pt 及其存储的模型配置，每个片段的种子均为 42。 源正方形图像通过带抗锯齿的双线性插值缩放到 512 × 512 512\times 512，使用已发布的 jonathandinu/face-parsing SegFormer 进行分割，并在其他区域置黑的情况下仅保留标签 1–18。 已发布的源跟踪器估计 FLAME 形状、表情、下颌/眼睛编码以及源相机。 对于源眼睛关键点，我们选择置信度最高的 S3FD 检测结果，若完全并列则按边界框面积打破平局。 源相机和六个眼部测量值在整个序列中保持固定；只有音频随时间变化。 我们保留该检查点的 FLAME 缩放参数 5、原生焦距参数 12、296 × 296 296\times 296 源提升平面、518 × 518 518\times 518 图像编码器输入，以及已发布的特征到 RGB 解码器。 PCM16 音频除以 32,768，并按 ( x − mean ⁡ ( x ) ) / var ⁡ ( x ) + 10 − 7 (x-\operatorname{mean}(x))/\sqrt{\operatorname{var}(x)+10^{-7}} 进行归一化。 facebook/hubert-large-ls960-ft 的最后隐藏状态为 3.24 秒的片段给出 161 个维度为 1,024 的向量。 视频帧 t t 使用索引为 2 ​ t − 8 , … , 2 ​ t + 7 2t-8,\ldots,2t+7 的 16 向量窗口，超出范围的索引用零向量填充。 这产生一个 81 × 16 × 1024 81\times 16\times 1024 的音频张量。 模型输出 512 × 512 512\times 512 的 RGB 图像。 仅用于预测的白背景转换在评估时应用。

paragraphs.en: We use the released real-image/audio pipeline with ffhq_1024.pkl , LipaintNet.pt , and the audio-to-expression weights from SadTalker_V0.0.2_256.safetensors . The input square is Lanczos-resized to 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 and passed through the released PTI/dlib face alignment using the 68-landmark predictor. We consistently select the largest detected face by inclusive bounding-box area, choosing the first detection on ties. The selected landmarks are passed to the released alignment, retaining its crop, padding, and bilinear quadrilateral transform to 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 . Each clip starts a fresh source-image inversion and pivotal tuning. Inversion runs 1,000 updates, jointly optimizing the latent, noise, and background codes with Adam ( 0.9 , 0.999 ) (0.9,0.999) , a peak learning rate of 0.01 0.01 , a linear 5% ramp-up and cosine 25% ramp-down. The latent mean uses 600 samples with seed 123; initial latent-noise strength is 0.05 0.05 , decaying to zero over 75% of the updates. The inversion objective is the released VGG16 feature distance plus noise regularization weighted by 10 5 10^{5} . PTI uses Adam at 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4} for at most 2,000 updates, stopping when the source AlexNet LPIPS reaches 0.06 0.06 . Its pixel-MSE and LPIPS weights are both one, and locality regularization is disabled. The subsequent released BFM09 fit uses a 224 × 224 224\times 224 image, 1,000 rigid and 500 non-rigid updates, both at learning rate 0.01 0.01 . Generation uses seed 0, truncation 0.7 0.7 , constant synthesis noise, the source-estimated camera, frozen background, expression scale 1.5 1.5 , and the released 0.5 0.5 reference-expression update weight. We retain the seven-frame moving average of the mouth-inpainting mask and the released deformation/inpainting operations. Native output is 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 ; benchmark export retains the generated frames before the presentation watermark.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用已发布的真实图像/音频流水线，包括 ffhq_1024.pkl、LipaintNet.pt 以及来自 SadTalker_V0.0.2_256.safetensors 的音频到表情权重。 输入方图通过 Lanczos 重采样调整为 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024，并使用 68 关键点预测器经由已发布的 PTI/dlib 人脸对齐处理。 我们始终按包含边界框面积选择最大检测到的人脸，若面积相同则选择第一个检测结果。 选定的关键点被传入已发布的对齐流程，保留其裁剪、填充以及双线性四边形变换到 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 的过程。 每个片段都重新开始一次全新的源图像反演和关键调优。 反演运行 1,000 次更新，使用 Adam（(0.9,0.999) (0.9,0.999)）联合优化潜码、噪声和背景编码，峰值学习率为 0.01 0.01，采用 5% 的线性上升和 25% 的余弦下降。 潜码均值使用种子 123 的 600 个样本；初始潜码噪声强度为 0.05 0.05，并在 75% 的更新过程中衰减为零。 反演目标是已发布的 VGG16 特征距离加上权重为 10 5 10^{5} 的噪声正则化。 PTI 使用学习率为 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4} 的 Adam，最多 2,000 次更新，当源图像 AlexNet LPIPS 达到 0.06 0.06 时停止。 其像素 MSE 和 LPIPS 权重均为一，且禁用局部性正则化。 随后使用已发布的 BFM09 拟合，采用 224 × 224 224\times 224 图像，1,000 次刚性更新和 500 次非刚性更新，二者学习率均为 0.01 0.01。 生成使用种子 0、截断值 0.7 0.7、恒定合成噪声、源估计相机、冻结背景、表情缩放 1.5 1.5，以及已发布的 0.5 0.5 参考表情更新权重。 我们保留嘴部修补掩码的七帧移动平均以及已发布的形变/修补操作。 原生输出为 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024；基准测试导出保留展示水印之前的生成帧。

sents.zh: 反演运行 1,000 次更新，使用 Adam（(0.9,0.999) (0.9,0.999)）联合优化潜码、噪声和背景编码，峰值学习率为 0.01 0.01，采用 5% 的线性上升和 25% 的余弦下降。

sents.en: The latent mean uses 600 samples with seed 123; initial latent-noise strength is 0.05 0.05 , decaying to zero over 75% of the updates.
sents.zh: 潜码均值使用种子 123 的 600 个样本；初始潜码噪声强度为 0.05 0.05，并在 75% 的更新过程中衰减为零。

sents.en: The inversion objective is the released VGG16 feature distance plus noise regularization weighted by 10 5 10^{5} .
sents.zh: 反演目标是已发布的 VGG16 特征距离加上权重为 10 5 10^{5} 的噪声正则化。

sents.en: PTI uses Adam at 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4} for at most 2,000 updates, stopping when the source AlexNet LPIPS reaches 0.06 0.06 .
sents.zh: PTI 使用学习率为 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4} 的 Adam，最多 2,000 次更新，当源图像 AlexNet LPIPS 达到 0.06 0.06 时停止。

sents.en: Its pixel-MSE and LPIPS weights are both one, and locality regularization is disabled.
sents.zh: 其像素 MSE 和 LPIPS 权重均为一，且禁用局部性正则化。

sents.en: The subsequent released BFM09 fit uses a 224 × 224 224\times 224 image, 1,000 rigid and 500 non-rigid updates, both at learning rate 0.01 0.01 .
sents.zh: 随后使用已发布的 BFM09 拟合，采用 224 × 224 224\times 224 图像，1,000 次刚性更新和 500 次非刚性更新，二者学习率均为 0.01 0.01。

sents.en: Generation uses seed 0, truncation 0.7 0.7 , constant synthesis noise, the source-estimated camera, frozen background, expression scale 1.5 1.5 , and the released 0.5 0.5 reference-expression update weight.
sents.zh: 生成使用种子 0、截断值 0.7 0.7、恒定合成噪声、源估计相机、冻结背景、表情缩放 1.5 1.5，以及已发布的 0.5 0.5 参考表情更新权重。

sents.en: We retain the seven-frame moving average of the mouth-inpainting mask and the released deformation/inpainting operations.
sents.zh: 我们保留嘴部修补掩码的七帧移动平均以及已发布的形变/修补操作。

sents.en: Native output is 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 ; benchmark export retains the generated frames before the presentation watermark.
sents.zh: 原生输出为 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024；基准测试导出保留展示水印之前的生成帧。

paragraphs.en: Frontal metrics decode each method’s exported videos. Real3D-Portrait retains its released imageio H.264 export and FFmpeg audio mux. SDTalk uses H.264 CRF 15 and NeRFFaceSpeech uses H.264 CRF 18, both with yuv420p pixels at 25 fps. We verify that each exported video contains all 81 frames. Frontal appearance scoring then follows Appendix B.2 ; the identity protocol remains the separate native-video procedure in Appendix B.7 .
paragraphs.zh: 正面指标用于解码各方法导出的视频。 Real3D-Portrait 保留其发布版本中的 imageio H.264 导出与 FFmpeg 音频混流。 SDTalk 使用 H.264 CRF 15，NeRFFaceSpeech 使用 H.264 CRF 18，两者均采用 yuv420p 像素格式和 25 fps。 我们验证了每个导出的视频都包含全部 81 帧。 随后按照附录 B.2 进行正面外观评分；身份协议仍采用附录 B.7 中单独的原始视频流程。

sents.en: Frontal metrics decode each method’s exported videos.
sents.zh: 正面指标用于解码各方法导出的视频。

sents.en: Real3D-Portrait retains its released imageio H.264 export and FFmpeg audio mux.
sents.zh: Real3D-Portrait 保留其发布版本中的 imageio H.264 导出与 FFmpeg 音频混流。

sents.en: SDTalk uses H.264 CRF 15 and NeRFFaceSpeech uses H.264 CRF 18, both with yuv420p pixels at 25 fps.
sents.zh: SDTalk 使用 H.264 CRF 15，NeRFFaceSpeech 使用 H.264 CRF 18，两者均采用 yuv420p 像素格式和 25 fps。

sents.en: We verify that each exported video contains all 81 frames.
sents.zh: 我们验证了每个导出的视频都包含全部 81 帧。

sents.en: Frontal appearance scoring then follows Appendix B.2 ; the identity protocol remains the separate native-video procedure in Appendix B.7 .
sents.zh: 随后按照附录 B.2 进行正面外观评分；身份协议仍采用附录 B.7 中单独的原始视频流程。

paragraphs.en: All five scored target cameras render the same frame-0 identity/expression state for a clip. We use physical RenderMe-360 camera calibration and the source frame’s 73 three-dimensional face landmarks to register coordinate systems. These metadata are used only for camera registration. Each clip has one similarity mapping X ′ = s ​ Q ​ X + b X^{\prime}=sQX+b . A target camera with camera-to-world rotation R j R_{j} and center c j c_{j} is transferred as R j ′ = Q ​ R j R^{\prime}_{j}=QR_{j} and c j ′ = s ​ Q ​ c j + b c^{\prime}_{j}=sQc_{j}+b ; its intrinsics follow the same frozen crop/resize used for that camera’s GT. The same mapping is shared across all target cameras of a clip.
paragraphs.zh: 对于一个片段，所有五个参与评分的目标相机渲染相同的第0帧身份/表情状态。 我们使用 RenderMe-360 的物理相机标定以及源帧的 73 个三维人脸关键点来配准坐标系。 这些元数据仅用于相机配准。 每个片段具有一个相似变换映射 X ′ = s ​ Q ​ X + b X^{\prime}=sQX+b 。 具有相机到世界旋转 R j R_{j} 和中心 c j c_{j} 的目标相机被变换为 R j ′ = Q ​ R j R^{\prime}_{j}=QR_{j} 和 c j ′ = s ​ Q ​ c j + b c^{\prime}_{j}=sQc_{j}+b ；其内参遵循与该相机 GT 所使用的相同的固定裁剪/缩放操作。 同一映射在一个片段的所有目标相机之间共享。

sents.en: All five scored target cameras render the same frame-0 identity/expression state for a clip.
sents.zh: 对于一个片段，所有五个参与评分的目标相机渲染相同的第0帧身份/表情状态。

sents.en: We use physical RenderMe-360 camera calibration and the source frame’s 73 three-dimensional face landmarks to register coordinate systems.
sents.zh: 我们使用 RenderMe-360 的物理相机标定以及源帧的 73 个三维人脸关键点来配准坐标系。

sents.en: These metadata are used only for camera registration.
sents.zh: 这些元数据仅用于相机配准。

sents.en: Each clip has one similarity mapping X ′ = s ​ Q ​ X + b X^{\prime}=sQX+b .
sents.zh: 每个片段具有一个相似变换映射 X ′ = s ​ Q ​ X + b X^{\prime}=sQX+b 。

sents.en: A target camera with camera-to-world rotation R j R_{j} and center c j c_{j} is transferred as R j ′ = Q ​ R j R^{\prime}_{j}=QR_{j} and c j ′ = s ​ Q ​ c j + b c^{\prime}_{j}=sQc_{j}+b ; its intrinsics follow the same frozen crop/resize used for that camera’s GT.
sents.zh: 具有相机到世界旋转 R j R_{j} 和中心 c j c_{j} 的目标相机被变换为 R j ′ = Q ​ R j R^{\prime}_{j}=QR_{j} 和 c j ′ = s ​ Q ​ c j + b c^{\prime}_{j}=sQc_{j}+b ；其内参遵循与该相机 GT 所使用的相同的固定裁剪/缩放操作。

sents.en: The same mapping is shared across all target cameras of a clip.
sents.zh: 同一映射在一个片段的所有目标相机之间共享。

paragraphs.en: The native camera is the source-fitted EG3D camera. We fix the canonical head anchor to ( 0 , 0 , 0.45 ) (0,0,0.45) , disable mirroring, and obtain the initial scale from the ratio of native-camera-to-anchor distance to physical-source-camera-to-landmark-centroid distance. These method-level choices were calibrated on RenderMe-360 subject 0041 using target-view diagnostics, checked on subject 0290, and then held fixed for all clips. With scale and source-camera rotation fixed, four source-framing iterations adjust translation, first along the optical axis to match the source landmarks’ RMS image radius, then laterally to match their image centroid. The resulting cameras are used directly for rendering. Target intrinsics are passed to the EG3D ray sampler with their first two rows divided by 512. Identity, audio-frame-0 expression, and the released head/torso compositor remain unchanged across targets.
paragraphs.zh: 原生相机是指与源适配的 EG3D 相机。 我们将规范头部锚点固定为 ( 0 , 0 , 0.45 ) (0,0,0.45)，禁用镜像，并通过原生相机到锚点的距离与物理源相机到关键点质心的距离之比来获得初始缩放。 这些方法层面的选择在 RenderMe-360 受试者 0041 上使用目标视角诊断进行校准，在受试者 0290 上进行检查，然后对所有片段保持固定。 在缩放和源相机旋转固定的情况下，四次源取景迭代用于调整平移，首先沿光轴匹配源关键点的 RMS 图像半径，然后横向匹配它们的图像质心。 所得的相机直接用于渲染。 目标内参传递给 EG3D 光线采样器，其前两行除以 512。 身份、音频第 0 帧表情以及发布的头部/躯干合成器在所有目标之间保持不变。

sents.en: The native camera is the source-fitted EG3D camera.
sents.zh: 原生相机是指与源适配的 EG3D 相机。

sents.en: We fix the canonical head anchor to ( 0 , 0 , 0.45 ) (0,0,0.45) , disable mirroring, and obtain the initial scale from the ratio of native-camera-to-anchor distance to physical-source-camera-to-landmark-centroid distance.
sents.zh: 我们将规范头部锚点固定为 ( 0 , 0 , 0.45 ) (0,0,0.45)，禁用镜像，并通过原生相机到锚点的距离与物理源相机到关键点质心的距离之比来获得初始缩放。

sents.en: These method-level choices were calibrated on RenderMe-360 subject 0041 using target-view diagnostics, checked on subject 0290, and then held fixed for all clips.
sents.zh: 这些方法层面的选择在 RenderMe-360 受试者 0041 上使用目标视角诊断进行校准，在受试者 0290 上进行检查，然后对所有片段保持固定。

sents.en: With scale and source-camera rotation fixed, four source-framing iterations adjust translation, first along the optical axis to match the source landmarks’ RMS image radius, then laterally to match their image centroid.
sents.zh: 在缩放和源相机旋转固定的情况下，四次源取景迭代用于调整平移，首先沿光轴匹配源关键点的 RMS 图像半径，然后横向匹配它们的图像质心。

sents.en: The resulting cameras are used directly for rendering.
sents.zh: 所得的相机直接用于渲染。

sents.en: Target intrinsics are passed to the EG3D ray sampler with their first two rows divided by 512.
sents.zh: 目标内参传递给 EG3D 光线采样器，其前两行除以 512。

sents.en: Identity, audio-frame-0 expression, and the released head/torso compositor remain unchanged across targets.
sents.zh: 身份、音频第 0 帧表情以及发布的头部/躯干合成器在所有目标之间保持不变。

paragraphs.en: We retain the frame-0 audio-deformed Gaussian cloud and source lifting planes. The physical source pose is estimated with OpenCV iterative PnP from source FLAME/FAN landmarks 17–67 (zero-based), the source intrinsics, and the native pose initialization. Scale is the ratio of the FLAME and physical-source interocular distances: FLAME eye centers use indices 36–41 and 42–47, and the RenderMe-360 73-point annotation uses indices 19–24 and 25–30. The physical and fitted source cameras then determine Q Q and b b . The target camera rasterizes the same 32-channel Gaussian features, after which the released StyleUNet produces RGB. Off-axis intrinsics are implemented in the projection and feature-raster canvas, cropped to 512 × 512 512\times 512 before decoding. The decoder noise state is shared across target views. The fixed prediction-only background conversion is applied after rendering, as in the frontal evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们保留第 0 帧的音频形变高斯点云和源提升平面。 物理源位姿使用 OpenCV 迭代式 PnP，从源 FLAME/FAN 关键点 17–67（从零开始编号）、源相机内参和原生位姿初始化来估计。 尺度取 FLAME 与物理源的瞳距之比：FLAME 眼睛中心使用索引 36–41 和 42–47，RenderMe-360 的 73 点标注使用索引 19–24 和 25–30。 随后由物理源相机和拟合源相机确定 Q Q 和 b b 。 目标相机对相同的 32 通道高斯特征进行光栅化，之后由发布的 StyleUNet 生成 RGB。 偏轴内参在投影和特征光栅化画布中实现，并在解码前裁剪到 512 × 512 512\times 512。 解码器的噪声状态在各个目标视角之间共享。 与正面评测一样，在渲染之后应用仅预测的固定背景转换。

sents.en: We retain the frame-0 audio-deformed Gaussian cloud and source lifting planes.
sents.zh: 我们保留第 0 帧的音频形变高斯点云和源提升平面。

sents.en: The physical source pose is estimated with OpenCV iterative PnP from source FLAME/FAN landmarks 17–67 (zero-based), the source intrinsics, and the native pose initialization.
sents.zh: 物理源位姿使用 OpenCV 迭代式 PnP，从源 FLAME/FAN 关键点 17–67（从零开始编号）、源相机内参和原生位姿初始化来估计。

sents.en: Scale is the ratio of the FLAME and physical-source interocular distances: FLAME eye centers use indices 36–41 and 42–47, and the RenderMe-360 73-point annotation uses indices 19–24 and 25–30.
sents.zh: 尺度取 FLAME 与物理源的瞳距之比：FLAME 眼睛中心使用索引 36–41 和 42–47，RenderMe-360 的 73 点标注使用索引 19–24 和 25–30。

sents.en: The physical and fitted source cameras then determine Q Q and b b .
sents.zh: 随后由物理源相机和拟合源相机确定 Q Q 和 b b 。

sents.en: The target camera rasterizes the same 32-channel Gaussian features, after which the released StyleUNet produces RGB.
sents.zh: 目标相机对相同的 32 通道高斯特征进行光栅化，之后由发布的 StyleUNet 生成 RGB。

sents.en: Off-axis intrinsics are implemented in the projection and feature-raster canvas, cropped to 512 × 512 512\times 512 before decoding.
sents.zh: 偏轴内参在投影和特征光栅化画布中实现，并在解码前裁剪到 512 × 512 512\times 512。

sents.en: The decoder noise state is shared across target views.
sents.zh: 解码器的噪声状态在各个目标视角之间共享。

sents.en: The fixed prediction-only background conversion is applied after rendering, as in the frontal evaluation.
sents.zh: 与正面评测一样，在渲染之后应用仅预测的固定背景转换。

paragraphs.en: We reuse each clip’s source-image fit and audio-frame-0 expression state. The known source crop, resize, and PTI alignment are composed into an image transform; RQ factorization of its product with the physical source intrinsics accounts for alignment roll. The canonical head anchor is the origin, and the initial scale is the native-source-camera distance divided by the physical-source-camera-to-landmark-centroid distance. Four source-framing depth/lateral iterations, as above, set translation while keeping scale and rotation fixed. Each transferred camera uses the full inverse-NDC intrinsic matrix and OpenGL camera-to-world matrix, with the proper basis change diag ⁡ ( 1 , − 1 , − 1 ) \operatorname{diag}(1,-1,-1) from OpenCV coordinates. For 512 → 1024 512\to 1024 rendering, focal lengths double and principal points transform as c ′ = 2 ​ c + 0.5 c^{\prime}=2c+0.5 . Camera-dependent mouth inpainting is recomputed at each view; the released ray-slot deformation and frozen-background behavior are retained. Native 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 novel-view renders are Lanczos-downsampled to 512 × 512 512\times 512 and scored directly.
paragraphs.zh: 我们复用每个片段的源图像拟合与第 0 帧音频表情状态。 已知的源裁剪、缩放与 PTI 对齐被组合成一个图像变换；该变换与物理源内参乘积的 RQ 分解可用于解释对齐时的滚转。 规范化头部锚点为原点，初始尺度为原生源相机距离除以物理源相机到关键点质心的距离。 按上述方法进行四次源取景深度/横向迭代，在保持尺度与旋转固定的同时设置平移。 每个迁移得到的相机使用完整的逆 NDC 内参矩阵和 OpenGL 相机到世界矩阵，并带有从 OpenCV 坐标系出发的恰当基变换 diag ⁡ ( 1 , − 1 , − 1 ) \operatorname{diag}(1,-1,-1) 。 对于 512 → 1024 512\to 1024 渲染，焦距翻倍，主点按 c ′ = 2 ​ c + 0.5 c^{\prime}=2c+0.5 变换。 依赖相机的嘴部修补在每个视角下重新计算；已发布的射线槽形变与冻结背景行为均予以保留。 原生 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 新视角渲染结果经 Lanczos 降采样至 512 × 512 512\times 512 后直接评分。

sents.en: We reuse each clip’s source-image fit and audio-frame-0 expression state.
sents.zh: 我们复用每个片段的源图像拟合与第 0 帧音频表情状态。

sents.en: The known source crop, resize, and PTI alignment are composed into an image transform; RQ factorization of its product with the physical source intrinsics accounts for alignment roll.
sents.zh: 已知的源裁剪、缩放与 PTI 对齐被组合成一个图像变换；该变换与物理源内参乘积的 RQ 分解可用于解释对齐时的滚转。

sents.en: The canonical head anchor is the origin, and the initial scale is the native-source-camera distance divided by the physical-source-camera-to-landmark-centroid distance.
sents.zh: 规范化头部锚点为原点，初始尺度为原生源相机距离除以物理源相机到关键点质心的距离。

sents.en: Four source-framing depth/lateral iterations, as above, set translation while keeping scale and rotation fixed.
sents.zh: 按上述方法进行四次源取景深度/横向迭代，在保持尺度与旋转固定的同时设置平移。

sents.en: Each transferred camera uses the full inverse-NDC intrinsic matrix and OpenGL camera-to-world matrix, with the proper basis change diag ⁡ ( 1 , − 1 , − 1 ) \operatorname{diag}(1,-1,-1) from OpenCV coordinates.
sents.zh: 每个迁移得到的相机使用完整的逆 NDC 内参矩阵和 OpenGL 相机到世界矩阵，并带有从 OpenCV 坐标系出发的恰当基变换 diag ⁡ ( 1 , − 1 , − 1 ) \operatorname{diag}(1,-1,-1) 。

sents.en: For 512 → 1024 512\to 1024 rendering, focal lengths double and principal points transform as c ′ = 2 ​ c + 0.5 c^{\prime}=2c+0.5 .
Camera-dependent mouth inpainting is recomputed at each view; the released ray-slot deformation and frozen-background behavior are retained.
sents.zh: 依赖相机的嘴部修补在每个视角下重新计算；已发布的射线槽形变与冻结背景行为均予以保留。

sents.en: Native 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 novel-view renders are Lanczos-downsampled to 512 × 512 512\times 512 and scored directly.
sents.zh: 原生 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 新视角渲染结果经 Lanczos 降采样至 512 × 512 512\times 512 后直接评分。
